title: Creative Director
description:
**About Constellation:**

Constellation is a cutting-edge AI solution that empowers highly regulated and complex industries with the insights and content they need to fuel their business. Specializing in industries such as healthcare, automotive, insurance, and finance, our powerful data/AI insights tools inform the creation of compliant content at scale. We enable our customers to harness their data and streamline the creation of localized, personalized content. A global, NYC-based company, Constellation has been revolutionizing marketing technology and data intelligence in order to drive exponential growth since its founding in 2016.

Constellation was named the 65th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America, the 10th Fastest-Growing Women-Owned Private Company, and the 7th Fastest-Growing Marketing & Advertising Company by Inc 500. In 2022, our platform won the Digiday Technology Award for Best Marketing Automation Platform.

**About the Role:**

We're seeking a visionary, hands-on Creative Director to join Constellation's creative leadership as our second Creative Director. Your role will sit at the intersection of creative technologist and creative director. This is a hands-on position - making, building, creating - every bit as much as it is a leadership role. You will hold the fort down with the team in NYC and serve as a bridge to the remote members working from other states. Working in tandem with our current Creative Director, you'll share ownership of the creative vision across client campaigns and Constellation's own brand, co-leading a team designers, and motion creatives from concept through final delivery and helping set the bar for the work we deliver to clients and to market.

This role sits at the intersection of big-idea creative leadership, AI-powered production, and regulated-industry rigor. The Creative Director will partner closely with the CMO and executive leadership, act as a senior creative voice with clients and in new business pitches, and help define how human craft and Constellation's GenAI and content automation systems work together to produce on-brand creative at scale.

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York City office.

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Work in tandem with Constellation's existing Creative Director, aligning on creative vision and standards, dividing account and project leadership, and presenting a unified creative direction to the team, clients, and leadership.
* Co-own the creative direction for client campaigns and Constellation's brand across paid social, display, email, video, motion, and branded templates, ensuring all work is on strategy, fresh, and built to grow our clients' business.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of senior creatives, designers, and motion artists, providing clear direction, ongoing feedback, and annual performance reviews.
* Identify, recruit, train, and develop top creative talent.
* Guide campaigns from concept through pre-production, production, and post-production, including social campaigns, motion ads, and video and photo shoots.
* Partner with copywriters to develop strong conceptual approaches that meet client objectives.
* Share final approval on creative quality with the other Creative Director, ensuring every deliverable meets Constellation's standards for craft, brand integrity, and regulatory compliance.
* Uphold and push brand guidelines across every execution, maintaining consistency while building variety across format and funnel.
* Champion the use of Constellation's proprietary GenAI and content automation systems, defining how AI and human creativity co-exist in daily workflows.
* Oversee modular design systems for multi-brand clients that balance creative freedom with brand compliance in regulated industries such as healthcare, automotive, and finance.
* Work alongside the CMO and executive leadership as a senior creative voice, contributing to strategic discussions and presenting creative concepts and rationale with confidence.
* Establish credibility with clients at all levels by developing deep knowledge of their brands, business, and organizations.
* Lead the creative contribution to new business efforts, from ideation through presentation.
* Partner with Client Services, Digital Product, Marketing, Sales, and Engineering to scope work, set priorities, and deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Monitor team workload and capacity, recommend freelance or vendor support when needed, and continuously improve the department's processes and workflows.
* Manage outside resources, including photographers, illustrators, and production vendors, from both a cost and creative standpoint.
* Stay ahead of trends in advertising, design, social, and AI-driven creative, and bring new ideas to the team to explore and test.

**Job Requirements:**

* 10+ years of creative experience in an agency or in-house setting, including 4+ years leading creative teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Design, Communications, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* A portfolio that shows big-idea thinking, taste, and versatility across brand, social, digital, and motion.
* Proven track record of leading integrated campaigns from concept to execution for major brands.
* Deep understanding of brand governance, visual identity, and building scalable design systems.
* Experience presenting to and building relationships with senior clients and executive leadership.
* A collaborative leadership style and proven ability to share ownership and decision-making with a creative peer.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to “zoom in and out” (big-picture thinking as well as attention to detail).
* Strong understanding of video and photo production, including pre-production, shoots, and post-production.
* Extensive experience and fluency in Claude and other AI platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro) and Figma.

**Nice to Haves:**

* Hands-on experience with GenAI, creative automation, or content personalization tools.
* Experience in regulated industries such as automotive, pharma/healthcare, insurance, or finance.
* Experience with performance-focused campaigns (paid social, programmatic, DCO).
* SaaS or marketing technology experience.

**Other Job Information:**

This job description is not all inclusive. Constellation reserves the right to amend this job description at any time.

**Benefits at Constellation:**

* Flexible PTO
* Hybrid work environment
* Competitive 401k plan with company match
* Commuter and Parking Benefits

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

Constellation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to providing a diverse and inclusive environment. Here at Constellation we don't discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally-recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

title: Design Director
description:
Design Directors lead the creative heart of a project, from early ideas to final delivery. You’ll set the vision, guide designers and writers through execution, and bring clarity and perspective to every stage of the work. You’re someone who can turn strategy into concepts, concepts into systems, and systems into beautiful, functional design, while helping the team and our clients see where an idea can go. You have a sharp eye for craft, communicate clearly and generously, and stay curious about new tools and where design is headed.
  
  
At Rudy, everyone designs, directors included. Staying hands-on is how we stay sharp, stay current and keep our work honest. Design Directors are leaders, collaborators and co-authors who move easily between making the work and guiding it. You’ll lead brands built from scratch, refreshes of established ones, and work that brings clarity to complex challenges across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints. You’re confident making creative calls and know how to bring out the best in the people around you.
  
  
We’re looking for unique talent: people who take creative risks, have a real appetite for experimentation, and are excited to push what’s possible, with past work that shows it. You’re curious, culturally tuned-in, and drawn to work that has both conceptual depth and visual ambition.
  
  
**This Role Will Have You**

* Lead design and creative direction across brand identity, systems, campaigns, digital, print and everything in between
* Design hands-on alongside the team, from early explorations to final craft
* Guide designers, writers and interns from exploration through execution, with clear direction and feedback
* Shape strategy into creative: turn research and messy inputs into compelling concepts and clear directions
* Partner with studio leadership, strategists, technologists and collaborators to bring ideas to life
* Shape and share the work with clients, building trust and bringing them along on the thinking
* Champion experimentation, AI-enhanced workflows and non-linear exploration, and push the work into new territory
* Hold a high bar for detail, quality and conceptual integrity across every project
* Mentor the team and help foster a studio culture of critique, generosity and play

**You Might Be a Great Fit If**

* You have 8+ years of experience in branding, digital design or adjacent creative fields, including leading projects
* You still love to make things, and you have a hard time imagining not designing
* You have mastery of the fundamentals – layout, type, hierarchy, storytelling – and more importantly, can teach them
* You take smart risks and are energized by ideas that haven’t been tried yet
* You love the big swing and the tiny detail, and know which one a project needs
* You have range: you can lead identity, digital and campaign work without losing clarity
* You give feedback that makes work and people better, and welcome it in return
* You value craft, but you’re not precious – you iterate, explore and evolve until the work sings

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience directing motion, 3D or illustration
* Fluency in Figma, AI workflows, prototyping tools and modern digital design practices
* Interest in culture, ideas, technology and the future of what creative studios can be

**Compensation And Benefits**

* Salary: $110 - $130k, plus quarterly profit sharing and performance bonuses
* 401(k) retirement plan
* 3 weeks paid vacation, plus paid sick days
* Two-week studio closure at the end of the year, plus culture-forward holidays
* Medical, dental and vision insurance, with premiums covered for individuals
* Complimentary access to wellness and mental health services
* Life insurance
* Annual company retreat
* 2 weeks a year to work from any time zone
* 6 Learning Days a year
* One design event, festival or conference a year, on us
* Pre-tax commuter benefits and FSA

This is a hybrid role based in our Chinatown, NYC studio. We have a strong preference for NYC-based candidates, but are open to remote for the right person, working East Coast hours.
  
  
Email us your portfolio, resume and a note on why you’d like to join us – and include ‘Design Director’ as the subject line: jobs@ru-dy.com

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
The range below is our good-faith estimate for the role. Where you land within it depends on your experience, skills, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process. If your expectations fall outside the range, please apply anyway. We'd love to talk.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$176,000—$238,100 CAD
  
  
**The Engine Edge: Perks & Benefits**
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
  
  

* **Equity for every employee:**
  Every employee gets stock. As Engine grows, so does your upside.
* **Benefits:**
  Check out our full list at engine.com/careers
* **Environments for Success:**
  Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

*Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more*

title: Senior Art Director - Brand Designer [Argentina]
location: Ciudad Evita, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a hybrid creative agency + advisory organization working alongside B2B marketing and revenue teams to drive growth.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US, Buenos Aires and Italy. We care about bold, specific work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
****The role****
We're looking for a Senior Art Director / Brand Designer to join our creative team.
  
  
You'll be part of Story, our brand and creative practice. It's where we help B2B companies find the story only they have the right to tell, then make it easier to sell and harder to ignore. That covers brand development, solution storytelling, and creative campaigns, all built from the market signals we uncover for our clients.
  
  
You'd sit somewhere between a classic Art Director and a brand designer. You'll get a strategic or conceptual brief, find the idea in it, build a visual world around that idea, and then see it all the way through to the finished piece. Think key visuals, campaign identities, and brand systems that still look great on every touchpoint.
  
  
You'll have a lot of autonomy here. We trust you to make good creative calls without someone looking over your shoulder. When feedback comes in, we want you to get what's really behind it, not just tick off the comments.
  
  
You'll also help us figure out how AI fits into the way we create. We're excited about new tools and use them to explore more and move faster. But the idea, the taste, and the final call? Those stay with people.
  
  
If you've got a strong portfolio across both branding and campaigns, we'd love to talk.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
****Find the idea.****

* Take strategy and messaging and turn them into visual concepts bold enough to stand out. Buyers ignore generic, and so do we.
* Explore a few different creative directions, share them, and know which one is worth fighting for.
* Bring real Art Direction thinking to every brief, not just great execution.

****Build brands that scale.****

* Design full brand identities and visual systems that help clients own a position competitors can't claim, not just a logo here and a one-off piece there.
* Lead brand refreshes that move things forward without losing what people already recognize.
* Make sure every system has the depth and flexibility to work wherever it ends up.

****Bring campaigns to life.****

* Create campaign concepts, key visuals, and campaign identities from a blank page, including ABM programs and thought leadership that give accounts already in motion a reason to engage.
* Take one big idea and carry it across websites, decks, social, paid media, events, and whatever comes next.
* Sweat the details: typography, layout, composition, color, and hierarchy.

****Create with AI, lead with judgment.****

* Use AI to go wider when you're exploring, test ideas quickly, and speed up production.
* Keep the concept in the driver's seat. The tools should serve the idea, not decide it.
* Edit hard and refine by hand until it feels like the brand and meets our bar.
* Share what's working with the team, because the tools keep changing and we learn faster together.

**Who You Are**

* You're a Senior Art Director or Brand Designer with 7+ years under your belt, ideally from a strong agency or studio.
* You think in concepts first. You can tell us the idea behind a project before you show us a single frame.
* You've created original key visuals and campaign identities, not just adapted someone else's.
* You love building systems, and you've designed complete brand systems with real depth.
* You're a little obsessed with craft: typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
* You're independent and decisive. You can go from brief to direction without needing your hand held.
* You're great with feedback. You use it to make the work better instead of applying every comment literally.
* You're curious about new tech, AI included, and you have the eye to tell what's actually good.
* You're fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
* You're comfortable working in English with a remote, multicultural team.

****Nice to have****

* You've used AI image, video, or design tools in your own creative work.
* You've worked at an agency or consultancy across different industries.
* You've done integrated or multi-channel campaigns.
* You've designed for websites and digital.
* You have a feel for motion and animation.
* You're a confident presenter who can stand behind the work.

**What We'd Love To See In Your Portfolio**
We care more about how you think than how many projects you've done. So show us:
  
  

* The idea behind each project.
* How a key visual grew into a full campaign system.
* The directions you explored, not just the one that won.
* Brand systems with depth, and how they play out across formats.
* Consistent, high craft.
* Where you used AI, what you kept, and what you threw out. We love seeing process work.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A chat with our Talent team.
* A portfolio review, where you walk us through two or three projects from idea to execution.
* A practical case, where you show us how you'd tackle a real-world creative challenge.
* A conversation with some of our senior team.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape how our brands and campaigns look, and how we create them.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US, Buenos Aires, and Italy.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Firdays, time off between holiday, and more.

****Ready to take the seat?****
No safe stories. If you want to own both the idea and the craft, we'd really like to hear from you.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.
  
  
We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.
  
  
Our Signal Intelligence methodology combines prioritized accounts, custom signal libraries, AI-assisted research, and 1:1 messaging based on what's actually happening inside a target account, before everybody else sees it.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
**The role**
We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative department.
  
  
This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.
  
  
You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.
  
  
And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.

* Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.
* Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.
* Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.
* Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

**Run the engine.**

* Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.
* Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.
* Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.
* Keep sharpening the creative workflow, from brief to review to client handoff.
* Be the single point of contact for every creative deliverable. On brand, on time, every time.

* Own the quality of everything we make, across every client and channel.
* Lead brand development work: positioning, messaging, and visual identity.
* Concept and lead campaigns, ABM programs, and digital advertising.
* Oversee website design and development.
* Give clear, useful direction to designers and copywriters.
* Work closely with our strategy and account teams so creative work serves each client's business goals.

* Decide where, when, and how AI tools and workflows are adopted in our day-to-day, based on one test: does it make the work better, and the work of making it better?
* Set practical guardrails for quality, brand fit, and client trust.
* Help the team build skill and confidence with new tools, and share what works across JumpSeat.

**Who You Are**

* A Creative Director, ACD, or Head of Creative from a strong agency, who has led a creative team directly.
* A department builder, not just a project lead. You've owned capacity, resourcing, and process, and you actually enjoy it.
* A true partner to delivery and account teams. Comfortable trading off priorities, scope, and timelines in the open.
* Experienced at bringing in and leading freelance talent.
* A versatile creative across branding, web, campaigns, and digital advertising, who still wants to roll up their sleeves.
* Quick to understand the unique aspects of a client's industry, culture and voice, so you can hit the ground running.
* Someone who loves growing people, and builds teams that stick together.
* Hands-on with AI tools, and clear-eyed about them. You already use them in your creative work, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they get in the way.
* A clear, confident presenter with existing and new clients.

**Nice to have**

* Fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Other design tools are a plus.
* B2B experience. Helpful, not required.
* You've led a team through a change in tools or workflows before.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A conversation with our Talent team.
* A practical case. You'll present how you'd approach a real-world challenge.
* A conversation with senior team members.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, time off between holidays, and more.

**Ready to take the seat?**
If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

title: Product Design Director

* Invent original ways to show energy: the personality of a number, the connection between two people, the changing energy of a day

* Shape a visual language that grows across the app, the web and our content
* Bring in and direct artists, illustrators and motion designers for commissioned work

* Exceptional visual taste, with strong typography and composition

title: Director, Performance Creative Strategy – Casino
description:
**About Us**
------------

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players' associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

**Primary Focus:**

As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
* Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
* Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
* Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
* Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
* Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
* Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
* Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
* Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
* Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
* Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
* Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
* Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
* Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

**How This Role Connects Across the Team:**

* Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
* Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
* Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
* Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
* Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
* Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that's optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.
* Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
* Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
* Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.
* Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.
* Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

title: Social Content Lead | Poppy & Peonies
description:
Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Director of Brand & Social to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity!

Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally.

Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom, I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born.

We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!

We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet, and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste, and we are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint.

**About The Role**

  

Poppy & Peonies is one of the fastest-growing accessory brands in Canada, and social is where most people meet us first. We're looking for a Social Content Lead who doesn't just manage our channels — they create what makes people want to follow them.

  

You're a creator at heart. You see content opportunities in everyday moments, have a camera roll full of ideas, and know how to turn a passing conversation into something worth watching. You're just as comfortable in front of the camera as you are behind it, and you can take an idea from concept to final edit without missing a beat.

  

You have a strong creative point of view, an instinct for what's culturally relevant and an understanding of what makes a brand feel like part of someone's world rather than another advertisement in their feed.

  

You think in Reels, TikToks, carousels and Stories. You've shot content, cut the edit that same afternoon and watched it outperform the campaign asset. You understand the importance of data, but you're equally comfortable trusting your creative instincts and trying something new.

  

Working closely with our Director of Brand & Social, you'll help shape how Poppy & Peonies shows up across social — from the idea, to the shoot, to the post, to what we learn from it. Your goal is to create content that builds brand affinity, grows our audience and brings our community closer to the brand.

### **The Opportunity**

**Create**

* Concept, shoot, edit and publish original, social-first content across Instagram, TikTok and emerging platforms.
* Be a regular on-camera presence for Poppy & Peonies, bringing our products, brand personality and storytelling to life in an authentic and engaging way.
* Develop fresh creative concepts, recurring content series and recognizable social formats that feel distinctly Poppy & Peonies.
* Create a thoughtful mix of product storytelling, styling content, entertainment, educational content, founder and team moments, and behind-the-scenes experiences.
* Be on set for brand shoots and content days, capturing platform-native content and ensuring social is considered throughout the creative planning process.
* Collaborate with photographers, videographers, models and creators to develop content that feels native to each platform.
* Write compelling hooks, captions, scripts and on-screen copy that reflect the Poppy & Peonies voice.
* Move comfortably between planned campaign content and spontaneous, reactive content opportunities.

**Stay Close to Culture**

* Stay immersed in social platforms, internet culture, fashion, lifestyle and the conversations shaping our community.
* Identify emerging trends, formats, audio and cultural moments, moving quickly on opportunities that feel authentic to the brand.
* Bring a strong creative point of view on what Poppy & Peonies should participate in, what we should sit out and where we can create something entirely our own.
* Draw inspiration from culturally relevant brands, creators and communities, both within and outside our industry.
* Experiment with emerging platforms, features and storytelling formats to keep our content fresh and relevant.

**Grow**

* Partner with our Director of Brand & Social to bring the organic social strategy to life.
* Own the social content calendar across product launches, campaigns, partnerships and always-on storytelling.
* Monitor content performance, including reach, saves, shares, watch time, audience growth, traffic and conversion, translating insights into creative decisions.
* Continuously experiment with hooks, formats, storytelling approaches and content styles, building on what resonates with our audience.
* Collaborate with Influencer, Ecommerce and Creative teams to ensure social supports broader brand and commercial objectives without losing its authenticity.

**Build Community**

* Create content that encourages conversation, participation and a genuine sense of connection with the brand.
* Work closely with our Community Coordinator to understand what our audience is talking about, asking for and responding to.
* Translate community insights into relevant content ideas, storytelling opportunities and feedback for the wider team.
* Build meaningful relationships with creators and ambassadors, identifying opportunities for collaborative content that feels natural and engaging.

**Collaborate & Lead**

* Support and develop the social and community team as the function continues to grow.
* Foster a collaborative creative environment where ideas are encouraged, explored and brought to life.
* Balance creative experimentation with organization, consistency and the ability to execute at pace.
* Build simple, scalable processes for content planning, production, approvals and performance reporting.

### **What You Bring to the Table**

* You bring experience creating social-first content for a consumer brand, creative agency or through your own established creator platform.
* You're a natural storyteller who is confident and comfortable appearing on camera, speaking to an audience and bringing a brand's personality to life.
* You can independently concept, shoot and edit compelling short-form video content, with proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing tools.
* You have a strong eye for visual storytelling, styling, composition and brand aesthetics.
* You understand internet culture and have an instinct for what makes content engaging, relatable, shareable and worth coming back for.
* You have demonstrated experience growing an engaged social audience and can speak to both the creative thinking and performance behind your work.
* You understand the nuances of Instagram and TikTok and how to create content that feels native to each.
* You use performance insights to inform creative decisions while remaining curious, experimental and willing to take creative risks.
* You have experience collaborating with creators, influencers and creative teams.
* You're organized, resourceful and comfortable balancing multiple creative projects in a fast-moving environment.
* You have a genuine interest in fashion, accessories, lifestyle and the communities surrounding them.

**We'd Love to See Your Work**

  

Alongside your application, please share a portfolio, social channels or examples of content you've personally concepted, created, filmed or edited.

  

We're interested in seeing your creative point of view, your storytelling ability and how you've brought ideas to life. Whether that's through your work with a brand, your own social platforms or independent creative projects, we'd love to see what you make and how you think.

### **The recruitment process**

* Video screen with Talent Advisor from Bloom
* Video Interview with Thuy, Art Director
* Video Interview with Abby, CMO
* Final Interview with Natalie Dusome, CEO + Founder of Poppy & Peonies
* Reference checks
* Offer

Applications will be accepted through the end of November. Candidates can expect to hear from us regarding next steps by November 30th 2026.

### **Location**

* We’re seeking an exceptional candidate based in the US or Canada who values the flexibility of remote work while embracing the excitement of in-person experiences.
* There will be occasional domestic and/or international travel for photoshoots, events, and team retreats.

### **Salary and Total Rewards**

* Annual Salary ranges from $85,000-$110,000
* Performance bonus
* 15 days of paid vacation per year
* Health benefits coverage
* $250 annual period & menstrual budget
* $1,000 annual allowance towards Poppy & Peonies product
* $400 home office setup allowance

*All compensation and benefit amounts are reflected in local currency (CAD/USD where applicable).*

  

At Bloom, we see conversations around compensation as a continuous discussion. We encourage you to share your desired compensation early in the interview process, but we also understand that as you learn more about the role and the full benefits package, your expectations might evolve. Don't worry - there will be plenty of opportunities throughout the process to revisit and adjust those conversations if needed.

**Our Commitment to you.**

Like Bloom, Poppy & Peonies is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equitable employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

We’re looking for motivated, compassionate people who are excited to contribute, grow with the team, and support the values that Poppy & Peonies believes in.

Poppy & Peonies is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Please inform us if you require any accommodation, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. Requests for any accessibility-related assistance can be made to sarah@buildwithbloom.com.  
  
**We believe transparency matters, especially as technology evolves.**  
  
At Bloom, we may leverage AI as a supportive tool when developing role descriptions, interview questions, take home assignments, and interview guides, where appropriate, with the goal of improving clarity, consistency, and accessibility for candidates. However, we do not use AI to source, assess, screen, or interview candidates. Every application is reviewed by a human, every interview is conducted by a human, and all hiring decisions are made by people, not automated systems. Human judgment, care, and accountability are central to how we hire.  
  
**About Bloom**  
  
**Bloom** is a full-service workplace design consultancy representing Poppy & Peonies at they build their team. As Talent Advisors, we will be the liaison between our Bloom Partner and yourself during this recruitment process. We do not use fancy tech to search through resumes at Bloom; every resume is reviewed by a human to ensure that we attain a consistent and equitable interview process. You will directly join our client’s team if you are selected as the successful candidate. We look forward to seeing your application!

title: Creative Director
description:
Description:

More than a decade ago, Ledge introduced America to the first-in pool chaise and modern

design forward furniture for a more compelling outdoor living experience. Today the award-

winning brand is recognized as the in-pool and poolside leader, adopted by discerning

homeowners and five star resort and residential properties around the world.

Our continued success is very much a consequence of our team members, the Ledge culture of

collaboration and innovation, and our unwavering belief in the importance of design distinction

in everything we do.

If you are committed to your growth, collaborative both in spirit and action, and seeking to join

a high performing team that both works hard and plays hard, we encourage you to apply.

**Job Overview**

At Ledge, we believe outdoor spaces are not just extensions of the home - they are living works

of art. We are seeking a Creative Director to make Ledge unmistakable and show customers why

our designs belong in their outdoor spaces.

This is a hands-on leadership role that owns how Ledge looks, sounds and makes people feel

across campaigns and customer touchpoints. You will set creative direction, design finished

work, coach our in-house team, and lead outside partners to deliver compelling product stories

for homeowners and Ledge Contract buyers. You will also own creative workflow and

production budgets while advancing our use of photography, 3D visualization, and AI-assisted

production. This position reports to the Chief Marketing and eCommerce Officer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set creative direction and evolve the brand. Define the visual and verbal standards that make Ledge distinctive, and use the strongest new work to keep brand guidelines current.
* Develop campaign concepts and design finished work. Translate audience needs and product features into clear stories, personally carrying selected pieces from initial layout through final artwork.
* Lead creative execution across channels. Guide the team in adapting concepts for launches catalog, paid media, email, and other touchpoints while maintaining a consistent brand experience.
* Build and coach the creative team. Provide clear briefs and actionable feedback, develop capabilities, and manage a roster of trusted freelancers, agencies, and specialists.
* Own creative workflow, capacity, and production budgets. Align work with the commercial calendar, establish clear scope and approval responsibilities, and deliver approved assets by agreed handoff dates.
* Art-direct photography and 3D production. Select locations, styling, lighting, and composition that showcase each design, and ensure imagery accurately represents product scale, finishes, and features.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted techniques where testing demonstrates better creative work or faster production. Maintain quality and product accuracy across all output.
* Partner with Marketing, eCommerce, Product, Sales, and CX to refine product stories, review creative performance, and apply customer feedback and test results to future briefs.
* Maintain an organized library of approved assets.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clear product storytelling. Creative helps customers understand what makes a Ledge design distinctive and worth owning, informed by feedback from Sales and CX.
* A distinctive and consistent brand. Reviewed campaigns meet the creative standard agreed with Marketing, bring fresh ideas, and depict products accurately.
* Reliable launch and campaign delivery. All agreed assets are ready by channel handoff dates, with on-time delivery tracked against the commercial calendar.
* Disciplined production spending. Shoots, freelancers, and agency work stay within approved campaign budgets, with scope and spending changes addressed early.
* More efficient creative production. Time from approved brief to final assets improves for comparable projects as workflow, staffing, 3D, and AI techniques are tested and refined.

Requirements:

* 8+ years of experience in design, advertising, or a related creative discipline, including work for a premium or lifestyle brand.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating both hands-on design and creative direction, with clear attribution of work personally created versus work directed.
* Experience advancing an established brand while preserving its recognizable strengths and translating product features into compelling customer stories.
* Experience coaching designers and leading in-house teams and external partners from brief through final delivery.
* Ability to manage production budgets, creative capacity, deadlines, and stakeholder approvals across concurrent projects.
* Experience art-directing photography and 3D visualization, with the judgment to evaluate photorealism, product accuracy, and AI-assisted output.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain creative decisions and give specific, constructive feedback.

*Portfolio submission: Include a campaign that moved an established brand forward, finished*

*pieces you designed yourself, and work you directed. Explain what you kept, what you changed,*

*how you judged the result, how you staffed the work, and one decision involving photography,*

*3D, or AI.*

At Ledge, we value diversity and inclusion and are committed to providing equal employment

opportunities to all individuals. We offer a competitive salary, benefits package, and the

opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a positive and supportive work environment.

title: Creative Director
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Creative Director is a strategic, commercially minded leader who leads Magenta’s creative organization across branded and private label home categories. This role is responsible for establishing the creative vision, developing and maintaining high-performing design teams, and translating consumer and trend insights into commercially successful products for mass retail customers.

The ideal candidate is not only an exceptional creative thinker, but also a proven people leader who has successfully lead teams, created scalable processes, and driven accountability across a design organization.

The Creative Director oversees Design Managers and Designers while partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, Marketing, and Retail partners to bring compelling seasonal and everyday collections to market.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Creative Vision & Strategy

* Establish a clear creative vision across all brands, categories, and retail channels.
* Translate macro consumer, lifestyle, and trend insights into actionable product strategies.
* Connect trend forecasting to retailer needs, customer behavior, assortment opportunities, and business objectives.
* Define seasonal creative direction, color strategy, materials, forms, finishes, and key visual storytelling elements.
* Ensure all creative output reflects both brand positioning and commercial viability.

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead, coach, and develop Design Managers. Coach Design Managers to ensure they lead high performing teams of Designers.
* Set clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct talent reviews, succession planning, hiring, and professional development planning.
* Mentor emerging creative leaders and build organizational capability.

Creative Excellence & Accountability

* Establish creative standards and ensure design excellence across all categories.
* Lead creative reviews and provide actionable feedback that elevates work.
* Create clear ownership structures and decision-making accountability.
* Ensure teams move efficiently from concept through execution.
* Balance creative innovation with speed, business objectives, and operational realities.

Trend-to-Product Translation

* Own the organization’s trend forecasting process.
* Establish repeatable frameworks for trend research, competitive shopping, consumer insights, inspiration gathering, and product translation.
* Guide teams in converting trends into product concepts, assortments, graphic assets, packaging, and brand storytelling.

Scalable Processes & Systems

* Develop and implement SOPs, templates, and creative operating mechanisms that increase efficiency and consistency.
* Improve frameworks for Creative Alignment Briefs, trend reporting, color direction, design reviews, product ideation, and sample reviews.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and eliminate administrative inefficiencies.

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Serve as the primary creative partner to Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, and Executive Leadership.
* Present creative direction to retailers and key stakeholders.
* Participate in customer meetings and strategic planning discussions.
* Build strong relationships internally and externally to drive alignment and influence outcomes.

Product & Category Leadership

* Lead creative direction across categories including Tabletop, Seasonal, Home Décor, Frames, Wall Décor, Garden, Pet, Gift, and Kitchen & Entertaining.
* Partner with overseas development teams to ensure design intent, quality, cost targets, and manufacturing feasibility are maintained throughout development.

**KEY QUALIFICATIONS**

Education

* Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Graphic Design, Illustration, Fine Arts, or related field.

Leadership Experience

* 8–15+ years of experience in Product Design, Creative Direction, Brand Design, or Product Development.
* Minimum 5+ years leading creative teams.
* Experience managing Design Managers, Senior Designers, or multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Proven track record in hiring, coaching, and developing talent.

Retail & Product Experience

* Strong experience supporting mass retail customers such as TJX, Target, Walmart, Kohl’s, Burlington, Ross, Michaels, HomeGoods, or similar channels.
* Experience developing products in home, seasonal, gift, tabletop, décor, or adjacent categories.
* Demonstrated success translating trends into commercially successful product collections.

title: Sr. Engineer - Product Security Response
description:
GE Vernova is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior (Sr.) Engineer – Product Security Response to join the Wind Product Security team. This role leads the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) function for the Wind portfolio of products. It is responsible for coordinated vulnerability disclosure, vulnerability triage and remediation coordination, and product-related cyber security incident response across wind turbines, SCADA systems, Wind Farm software, and digital service platforms.
  
  
Wind farms are critical energy infrastructure, and adversaries are evolving quickly, including through AI-enabled tooling and attacks targeting operational technology (OT) environments. This role is the front line for coordinating the response in the underlying systems in a wind generation facility that GE Vernova’s customers rely on to generate and deliver power. It ensures vulnerabilities in Wind’s products are handled quickly, transparently, and in line with industry standards and regulatory timelines.
  
  
This position reports to Wind's Product Security Leader, who oversees Wind's Product Security Team. The PSIRT Leader works in close partnership with GE Vernova's enterprise PSIRT, CNA (CVE Numbering Authority) program, and CERT functions to keep Wind's cyber response operations aligned with company-wide processes.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role with high visibility to business and executive leadership, and direct engagement with customers, suppliers, and industry partners as well as possibly government agencies and regulators as required.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Lead Wind security response operations end to end:** Own intake, triage, tracking, remediation coordination, and public disclosure of vulnerabilities affecting Wind products, following GE Vernova's PSIRT standard and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) procedure.
* **Manage coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD):** Work with external researchers, customers, vendors, and government bodies, and manage the full lifecycle of vulnerability reports from receipt through closure and disclosure.
* **Support the CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) program for Wind:** Work with the GE Vernova’s enterprise CAN team to ensure timely, accurate CVE records and security advisories for Wind related products.
* **Drive regulatory reporting readiness:** Support compliance with mandatory notification timelines, including EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) reporting to ENISA and national CSIRTs, and with other applicable regional and customer requirements.
* **Lead product-related incident response:** Direct the response to cyber security incidents involving Wind products at customer sites, coordinating with engineering, services, legal, GE Vernova CERT, commercial, and customer teams. Maintain and exercise incident response playbooks specific to wind turbines, wind farm SCADA, and digital service platforms.
* **Assess third-party and component vulnerabilities:** Evaluate the impact of vulnerabilities in third-party and open-source components (e.g., operating systems, hypervisors, network and firewall software, and firmware) on Wind products, using SBOM and product configuration data. Provide prioritized remediation guidance.
* **Coordinate remediation across Wind subsystems:** Work with product development, engineering, projects, services, and R&D teams to define fixes, mitigations, compensating controls, and customer guidance. Work with the Wind patch validation effort so patches are validated against fielded SCADA and controller configurations.
* **Apply risk-based prioritization:** Use CVE, CVSS, CWE, exploit intelligence, and the Wind product context (exposure, deployment architecture, impact to operations and safety) to drive consistent severity and remediation decisions.
* **Deploy AI-enabled tooling:** Lead the adoption of AI-powered and automated tools for vulnerability scoring, triage, threat intelligence, and situational awareness, to scale PSIRT capacity as threat volume grows.
* **Engage with external stakeholders:** Represent Wind with customers, government agencies, law enforcement, regulators, and industry information sharing groups (e.g., E-ISAC). Support sensitive communications during active incidents.
* **Support customer communications:** Provide technical guidance in response to customer security inquiries, and review security advisories and customer-facing documentation for accuracy and clarity.
* **Establish governance and metrics:** Define and report on key performance indicators.
* **Build cross-functional partnerships:** Align Wind PSIRT with the enterprise CERT and PSIRT functions, and establish PSIRT liaisons across Wind engineering and services teams.
* **Improve processes and guidelines:** Contribute to internal product security processes, playbooks, and hardening guidance. Lead lessons-learned reviews after incidents and significant vulnerability events.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
* Major experience in operational technology (OT) cybersecurity or product security. Alternatively, significant experience combining OT/product cybersecurity with relevant experience in IT cybersecurity, SCADA operations, or product design and development.
Strong experience in incident response and vulnerability management for customer-facing products or systems, including vulnerability assessment, remediation coordination, and security incident handling.  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Significant experience in cybersecurity, including deep expertise in PSIRT operations, vulnerability management, or product incident response, ideally in an industrial, energy, or OT context.
* Proven experience leading or operating a PSIRT function, including hands-on management of coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) and customer-facing security incidents.
* Experience building or scaling a PSIRT function, or establishing a CNA program.
* Experience working with engineering and product teams to drive vulnerability remediation through to closure.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, CEH, or GICSP.
* Deep knowledge of vulnerability process and concepts (e.g., CVE, CVSS, and CWE).
* Direct experience with GE Vernova products or equivalent OT/industrial energy systems, including wind turbine, SCADA, or controls product security knowledge.
* Familiarity with energy-sector ISACs such as E-ISAC.
* Knowledge of the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and related vulnerability and incident reporting obligations.
* Strong understanding of operational technologies (e.g., PLCs, controllers) and/or protocols (e.g., Modbus, Profinet, DNP3, OPC [DA, AE, UA], IEC 61850) used in power generation, wind farms, and SCADA environments.
* Experience applying AI or automation to vulnerability management, triage, or threat intelligence.
* Familiarity with cloud security, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes),
* Master's degree in a relevant field.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional and global teams, and to stay effective under pressure during active incidents.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems, and to lead through influence without direct authority.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex security issues to technical, executive, and customer audiences.

**Job Description**
===================

**GE Vernova** **- The Energy to Change the World**

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

**Let’s Talk about the Role**

As a member of the Digital Technology organization within WIND DT, the Sr. Manager Industrial Automation & Control Tower will serve as the primary DT/IT leader responsible for Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) programs across all Wind manufacturing factories globally. This role will own the OT and IIoT pillar of the Manufacturing Transformation roadmap, defining the strategy and execution for a Manufacturing Control Tower, including Digital Twin capabilities, IIoT-enabled data collection, and near real-time reporting integrating both IT and OT data sources.

  
  

Key responsibilities

  

* Serve as the global DT/IT owner for all OT and IIoT programs across GE Vernova's Wind manufacturing factories worldwide, ensuring alignment of technology strategy with business objectives.
* Define, own, and drive the OT and IIoT workstream within the Manufacturing Transformation 4.0 roadmap, establishing the vision, milestones, and execution plan in alignment with the overall digital evolution strategy for Wind manufacturing operations.
* Develop and execute the strategy for a **Manufacturing Control Tower**, enabling centralized visibility and decision-making across all global Wind factory operations.
* Lead the design and implementation of **Digital Twin** capabilities for manufacturing processes, enabling simulation, predictive analytics, and continuous optimization of factory performance.
* Architect and deliver **near real-time reporting** solutions that integrate IT and OT data streams, providing actionable insights to plant managers, operations leaders, and executive stakeholders.
* Partner with plant-level OT teams, HQ DT, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless integration of shop-floor systems (SCADA, PLC, MES,etc) and IIoT platforms with enterprise systems.
* Establish governance frameworks and standards for OT/IT convergence across all manufacturing sites, ensuring HQ Cybersecurity team review and approval of all designs as part of project execution.
* Manage multiple concurrent programs and projects across geographies, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery and alignment with the global manufacturing strategy.
* Communicate effectively with business stakeholders at all levels, providing regular progress reports, risk assessments, and executive briefings on the Manufacturing 4.0 program.
* Evaluate emerging technologies (IIoT, Edge Computing, AI/ML, Cloud Platforms) and recommend adoption strategies that accelerate the smart factory vision.
  

  

**What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, with extensive experience in manufacturing technology, OT/IT convergence, or industrial digital transformation.
* Proven experience leading **Smart Factory** initiatives in a manufacturing environment, preferably in energy, heavy industry, or discrete manufacturing.
* Knowledge of OT and IIoT systems including SCADA, PLC, MES platforms, and their integration with enterprise IT systems.
* Strong understanding of Digital Twin methodologies and Manufacturing Control Tower / Command Center concepts, with the ability to contribute to their design, evaluation, and implementation in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience with real-time data architecture, IIoT platforms, and edge-to-cloud data pipelines and experience managing complex, multi-site, global programs and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal & written) in English; Spanish is a plus.
* Willingness to travel internationally (up to 25–30%) to Wind manufacturing sites globally.
  

  

**What will make you stand out**

* Master's degree or MBA with a focus on technology, operations, or digital transformation.
* Experience with cloud-based IIoT platforms (e.g., AWS IoT, Azure IoT, GE Predix/Proficy) and familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks for OT environments.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to influence without direct authority across a matrixed organization, and experience managing multi-year transformation programs in global context
* Background in the energy or wind industry and ability to bridge the gap between shop-floor operations and executive strategy, translating technical concepts into business value.
  

  

**Our Culture**

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

  

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

  

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!

  

**We're determined to be the best place to grow**

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.

  

We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.

  

**Inclusion & Diversity**

We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.

  

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.

  

Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved
