title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**This isn’t another growth job**

Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.

We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.

**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE GROWTH MEANS AT PARADOX**
------------------------------------------

Our growth machine has to be able to:

**1. Generate hypotheses.** Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.

**2. Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.

**3. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.

**4. Ship its hypotheses.** Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox,

We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.

We do that by merging :

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.

You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Build the agents that run growth**

* The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.

### **2. Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night**

* The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.

### **3. Build a creative machine with taste**

* The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Build measurement that checks itself**

* The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.

### **5. Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**You’ll own these KPIs:** LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.

**Desired outcomes:** conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.

**Tools you’ll master:** GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.

If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.

If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.

If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.

If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…

If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…

If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.

Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s Growth team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the growth vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.

If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

An informal atmosphere in a dynamic media company with opportunities for ownership and personal development.

title: Editorial Lead (Madrid based)
description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet The Team**

Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do, and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our network is composed of Secret London, Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Sydney, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta, and More!

**The Role**

We are seeking an experienced Editorial Executive to lead the creation of compelling content for our media outlets for our expansion into new markets. Reporting directly to our VP of Media, you will play a pivotal role in managing a growing team of passionate editors, writers, video producers, and social media creatives.

**What You´ll Do**

* Drive and take full responsibility for the strategy and growth of theSouthern Europe market.
* 1-on-1 management, ensuring clear workflows, and providing individual feedback.
* Crafting, communicating, and executing a creative vision for the entire Secret Media Network.
* Collaborating with Editors, Staff Writers, and the video and social team to establish and maintain high editorial standards, adhering to the brand's identity and tone of voice.
* Leading and guiding the team to foster growth, inspire creativity, and reach new audiences.
* Working with experienced editors to elevate our content in established cities, with an eye toward expandable formats.
* Analyzing data for cities in your region based on SMN's internal KPIs, and leveraging findings to inform future strategy.
* Identifying editorial partnership opportunities to broaden SMN content to a diverse audience.
* Taking a hands-on approach to initiate key content-creation initiatives.
* You will also be responsible for coordinating, assigning, and prioritizing editorial work within the team, collaborating with other Fever departments, and developing and analyzing audience-growth strategies. Your role will involve celebrating 'wins' and sharing best practices network-wide.
* Having a deep understanding of how the business operates and translating that knowledge into content strategies that support revenue, audience growth, and overall company objectives.
* Building and optimizing a successful content-driven conversion funnel, ensuring that storytelling, formats, distribution, and audience insights work together to drive measurable conversions.

**Who You Are**

* Proficiency in English. Any other extra language is a plus.
* +5 years of experience working for a newsroom, content agency, creative agency, or digital media property.
* Strong leadership skills with a minimum of 2 years of team management experience.
* Deep passion for journalism, especially at the local level, social media, and digital marketing.
* Expertise in media mapping and the ability to collaborate with external partners (advertising agencies, media agencies, TV/Animation companies).
* Digital fluency and hands-on knowledge of the current social media landscape, including platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, etc.
* Ability to inspire creative teams and customers, strong presentation skills.
* Data-driven and business-savvy with superb writing skills and creative flair.
* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.
* Ability to convert content creators' economy into growth opportunities.
* Team player attitude.
* Additionally, proficiency in using WordPress, familiarity with Photoshop, Canva, and knowledge of other image/video editing software is preferred. Powerful media network contacts and connections will be highly appreciated.

**Why You´ll Love It Here**

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
* Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
* Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.
* Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
* Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
* Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

*Instantly recognizable, The Ritz-Carlton Tenerife, Abama is the island's most iconic resort:**an oasis of relax where the sea, land, and subtropical vegetation blend seamlessly with iconic Moorish-inspired architecture. The resort's 462 guest rooms and suites, divided between the vibrant Citadel and the exclusive Retreat, enjoy magnificent views of the Atlantic Ocean, Mount Teide, or the resort's lush gardens.*

*An award-winning culinary destination in its own right, this 5-star resort in Tenerife features world-class restaurants ranging from light, casual dining to Michelin-starred fine dining experiences. Offering a haven of escape, this timeless resort boasts multiple swimming pools, a 2,500 m² Spa & Fitness Center, and the largest Ritz Kids program in Europe.*

**JOIN OUR TEAM!** ... as a **Sommelier** at **The Ritz-Carlton Tenerife, Abama**.

**Who are we looking for?**

Are you passionate about wine, fine dining, and delivering exceptional guest experiences? As a **Sommelier at MB\*\* by Martin Berasategui**, you will play a pivotal role in shaping extraordinary dining experiences within a **two Michelin Star restaurant**, leading the wine program and guiding guests through expert recommendations and carefully curated pairings.

We are looking for a dedicated professional with extensive wine knowledge, a passion for luxury hospitality, and the ability to share the culture of wine in an engaging, elegant, and memorable way. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an internationally recognized gastronomic environment where excellence, innovation, and attention to detail are at the heart of everything we do.

**Your responsibilities will include...**

* Leading the restaurant’s wine program, ensuring a wine selection that reflects the culinary philosophy and standards of excellence of the establishment.

* Advising guests on the selection of wines, champagnes, spirits, and other beverages, providing personalized recommendations based on individual preferences and tasting menus.

* Designing and executing wine pairings that complement and enhance the culinary creations of the kitchen team.

* Presenting, opening, decanting, and serving wines according to the highest service and etiquette standards.

* Managing and continuously developing the wine list, ensuring it remains current, relevant, and reflective of exceptional quality.

* Overseeing the wine cellar, ensuring optimal storage conditions, inventory rotation, and product preservation.

* Managing wine and beverage inventories, monitoring consumption trends, stock levels, and opportunities for optimization.

* Participating in the selection and purchasing of wines, maintaining professional relationships with wineries, distributors, and suppliers.

* Identifying opportunities to increase revenue through the strategic promotion of premium wines, exclusive labels, and unique wine experiences.

* Training, coaching, and developing the restaurant team on wine knowledge, pairings, and beverage service standards.

* Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of wine regions, producers, vintages, market trends, and industry developments.

* Working closely with the Culinary and Restaurant teams to ensure a seamless and fully integrated dining experience.

* Managing guest inquiries, feedback, and special requests with professionalism and a strong service-oriented approach.

* Ensuring compliance with all legal regulations and company policies regarding the responsible service of alcoholic beverages.

* Supervising adherence to operational procedures, quality standards, and corporate policies.

* Maintaining the highest standards of personal presentation, professionalism, and attention to detail.

* Protecting the confidentiality of guest and company information.

* Performing other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors or management.

**What we are looking for in you...**

* High School Diploma, Secondary Education, or equivalent qualification.

* A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience as a Sommelier in fine dining restaurants, Michelin-starred establishments, luxury hotels, or similarly demanding environments.

* Extensive knowledge of domestic and international wines, wine-producing regions, winemaking processes, vintages, and market trends.

* Proven experience in developing and executing high-level food and wine pairing programs.

* Ability to create personalized wine experiences and deliver added value to guests.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

* Strong leadership capabilities, with experience in training and mentoring teams.

* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to service excellence.

* Ability to perform effectively under pressure while maintaining the highest quality standards.

* Strong commercial awareness and results-oriented mindset.

* Professional, proactive, and continuously improvement-focused attitude.

* Fluency in Spanish and English; additional languages will be considered an asset.

* Flexibility to work rotating shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

* Valid work authorization for Spain.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* WSET Level 3 or Diploma certification, Court of Master Sommeliers, Certified Sommelier, ASI certification, or equivalent qualifications.

* Previous experience within Michelin-starred restaurants or internationally recognized fine dining establishments.

* Advanced knowledge of Champagne, rare and collectible wines, premium spirits, and luxury beverage offerings.

* Experience managing high-value wine cellars featuring prestigious national and international labels.

* Experience developing wine lists and implementing beverage profitability strategies.

* Familiarity with luxury hotel and fine dining service standards.

* Demonstrated passion for gastronomy, wine culture, and creating memorable guest experiences.

* Participation in wine competitions, professional certifications, tastings, or industry-related events within the world of wine and sommellerie.

**How we inspire you...**

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Create believable, high-quality animations and directly participating in implementing them in games.
* Define the animation style and workflows for new products under the supervision of the Producer and Lead Artist.
* Be able to rigging/skinning with low to medium polygon counts.
* Take active part in the game creation process by interacting with the design team.
* Contribute effectively to the art pipeline while understanding target platform constraints.
* Have a strong time management skills to reach project deadlines/milestones.
* Collaborate with the rest of the Art Team to obtain a consistent visual style for the game.
* Work with the Programming Team to integrate your animations in the game while respecting technical constraints.

  
**Qualifications**

**PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS**

In order for your application to be considered, you must submit a portfolio or other samples of your work. All portfolios must contain a detailed shot breakdown of the work. **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Examples of basic cycles of a character. Cycle of walk, run, idle, attack, jump, etc.
* Examples of physics of movement. It can be a character doing parkour, moving weight, a skateboarder, etc.
* Examples of combination of cycles. Idle + attack, idle + run + attack, etc.

* Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.
* Good command of English.
* Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus

* Working Unity experience.
* Have modelling skills (2D/3D), knowledge and experience of Blender, Unity, particle effects creation programs (e.g. combustion, particle illusion, Fork) and motion graphics programs (eg After Effects).

* Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.

**Why Mozilla?**

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

#### **About this team and role:**

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

#### **What you'll do:**

**Risk Management**

* Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests
* Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented
* Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress
* Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting
* Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation

**Compliance and Audit**

* Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests
* Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews
* Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date
* Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners

**Security Program Support**

* Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards
* Support data classification and data governance efforts by maintaining documentation, tracking adoption, and coordinating with data owners
* Assist with business impact analysis (BIA) and business continuity/disaster recovery (BC/DR) activities, including plan maintenance, exercise coordination, and follow-up on gaps
* Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items
* Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up

**GRC Operations and Tooling**

* Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work
* Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation

* Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years)
* Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST
* Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative, curious mindset and a genuine desire to learn and take on new challenges
* Hands-on experience with a GRC platform (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar)
* Experience supporting an audit (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)
* Exposure to any of: vulnerability management, third-party risk, BC/DR, secure development practices, or penetration test coordination
* Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, SQL, or workflow tools) to improve GRC processes
* A relevant certification or one in progress (e.g., Security+, CISA, CISM, CISSP)

Our impact is evident in the awards and accolades we are achieving as an employer of choice and on behalf of our patients worldwide.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how **Global CMS Optimizely Platform Manager** role will make an impact:

Optimizely is becoming Viatris' global content management platform, supporting more than 260 commercial websites and integrating with DAM, SFID, analytics platforms, and multiple third-party services and APIs.

The **Global CMS Optimizely Platform Manager** will provide the hands-on platform expertise required to support the CMS foundation build and multi-year website migration, working closely with OCE Product Management, Optimizely, implementation partners, IT, architecture, and business teams.

The role will support the technical execution of the foundation, integrations, migration, testing, rollout, and issue resolution, while ensuring that scalability, reuse, automation, and self-service are embedded into the platform from the beginning. As the platform matures, the role will continue to drive platform optimization, reusable capabilities, integration management, and self-service enablement across markets.

**Key responsibilities for this role include:**

**Understand:**

* Understand business requirements across markets and translate them into technical solutions within the Optimizely CMS ecosystem.
* Align and communicate with global/regional/country stakeholders, such as marketing, IT, and architecture, to define technical needs, prioritize work, and plan integration and migration activities.
* Act as the technical bridge between business requirements, architecture, and development, serving as a point of contact for platform-related technical inquiries.
* Evaluate the platform's integration landscape, including DAM, SFID, SFMC, analytics platforms, and 20+ third-party service APIs, to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment activities for the DXP (Digital Experience Platform), including environment management, release processes, and monitoring across development, staging, and production.

**Design and Improve:**

* Partner with Optimizely architecture and product teams to define and design the technical approach for the CMS Foundation Build and Migration Project on Optimizely CMS, including the migration path from legacy platforms to a composable, API-first architecture.
* Work with cross-functional business and technical teams to define integration requirements, technical architecture, and a build roadmap that keeps the headless CMS scalable and flexible as the platform grows.
* Design the content modeling approach (content types, components/blocks, atomic content, brand design systems, page templates, and taxonomies) needed to support 260+ sites across multiple languages, markets, and business lines within a single headless CMS instance.
* Define the technical SEO(Search Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) foundation for the platform, including structured data/schema markup, AI-promoted metadata governance, URL and redirect strategy, and content signals that improve visibility in both traditional search and AI-driven answer engines.
* Define the technical approach for personalization and experimentation (e.g., Optimizely Web/Feature Experimentation) so that content and campaigns can be targeted and tested reliably across markets.
* Define content governance guardrails, permissions, workflows, publishing rules, and reusable templates that keep 260+ sites consistent while allowing local market flexibility.
* Identify and scope Opal AI-driven use cases, such as GEO-informed content creation and optimization, that turn business ideas into working solutions using Python, GraphQL, and APIs.

**Execution:**

* Drive the platform-level execution of the CMS foundation build and website migration, working with implementation partners and internal teams across requirements, configuration, migration, validation, testing, cutover, and rollout.
* Build and maintain integrations between the CMS and DAM, SFID, consent management, and analytics platforms, as well as third-party service APIs, using GraphQL and RESTful APIs for content delivery.
* Implement and maintain technical SEO and GEO best practices across the platform, including structured data, sitemaps, page performance and Core Web Vitals, and content structuring that supports discoverability by both search engines and AI/LLM-based answer engines.
* Configure and support personalization and A/B testing capabilities on the platform, working with marketing and content teams to enable targeted, tested experiences across markets.
* Enforce content governance standards such as templates, publishing workflows, permissions, and reusable components to keep the platform consistent and maintainable on a scale.
* Troubleshoot technical issues across the CMS platform and its integrations, working with engineering, architecture, and vendor teams to drive timely resolution.
* Build and support Opal AI-driven solutions and use cases for content creation, optimization, and other AI-driven engagement capabilities.
* Design and evolve a self-service operating model, govern component libraries, and documentation, and training that lets local market and business teams build, publish, and manage content independently without compromising platform integrity.

**Optimization and Continuous Improvement:**

* Develop a deep understanding of platform performance, integration reliability, and technical debt to inform continuous improvement.
* Define technical standards, integration patterns, and reusable practices that support consistent scaling of integrations, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities across markets.
* Document technical solutions and platform capabilities and share learnings across global teams to support ongoing platform maturity.

**The minimum qualifications for this role are:**

* An Experienced Technical Solution Owner: You have hands-on development or build experience with Optimizely CMS and/or Episerver CMS, and have led technical delivery for complex, multi-site web platforms.
* A Problem Solver: You love solving problems and have close attention to detail, are confident in troubleshooting technical issues across a platform and its integrations, and in managing multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
* Integration Experience: You understand RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and integration layers between different systems such as DAM, SFID, consent management, and analytics platforms, and know how to design integrations that ensure seamless, reliable data flow.
* Development Skills: You have practical experience with Python, GraphQL, and API-based development, and are comfortable building working solutions rather than only specifying requirements.
* Headless CMS Architecture: You have working knowledge of headless/composable CMS architecture (API-first content delivery, decoupled front ends, content modeling with reusable components and blocks) and can evaluate trade-offs to keep a platform scalable and flexible as it grows.
* CMS Migration Experience: You have hands-on experience migrating websites from a legacy or monolithic CMS (e.g., Sitecore, WordPress, or similar) to a modern platform such as Optimizely, including content and URL migration, redirect mapping, template/component rebuild, and phased or multi-site cutover planning.
* Technical SEO & GEO Experience: You understand technical SEO fundamentals (structured data/schema markup, metadata, site performance, Core Web Vitals, sitemaps, crawlability) as well as emerging GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) practices for improving content visibility and citation in AI-driven search and answer engines.
* Content Governance: You understand content governance practices, including publishing workflows, permissions, and reusable templates/components, and know how to balance global consistency with local market autonomy on a scale.
* AI-Enabled Capabilities: You have familiarity with AI-driven content tools or platforms (e.g., Opal AI or similar) and are excited to build AI-driven use cases for content creation, optimization, and engagement.
* Translate Requirements to Solutions: You can translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate effectively with both business stakeholders and development teams.
* Assess Technical Recommendations: You can independently assess and challenge technical recommendations from implementation partners and vendors, ensuring solutions remain aligned with Viatris' scalability, reuse, maintainability, and self-service objectives.

We're hiring a Brand Manager to own This Month's Craft end to end, with churn as your main KPI. This Month's Craft is a monthly craft subscription box with two tracks: Creative (relaxing, artistic crafts) and DIY (practical, skill-building crafts).

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. You'll also analyse who we acquire, how the cancellation flow and failed-payment recovery perform, and work closely with customer service and analyze customer feedback. Just as important: you dig into why things happen and check whether each change actually worked. We need your product judgement and your ownership.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Find, test and approve the crafts.** Own the box pipeline for both tracks. Scout craft ideas, order samples, make every kit yourself, and approve or reject it.
* **Own kit quality.** Every kit must be finishable at its stated level: clear instructions, the right tools and materials, nothing missing, packaging that survives shipping. Catch problems before a box ships, not in the reviews.
* **Plan the box calendar.** Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.
* **Learn from subscribers.** Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.
* **Own churn.** It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.
* **Protect acquisition quality.** Work with performance marketing on channels and first-box offers, and avoid offers that attract one-box buyers.
* **Keep the subscription running smoothly.** Own the cancellation flow (reasons, offers, copy) and failed-payment recovery, with saves that still hold a month later.

title: AI & Cybersecurity Conformity Assessment Specialist – Machinery Safety
description:
**Company Description**

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**

Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**

**Main Purpose of Role**

* Act as the One NoBo technical reference for the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (focusing on cyber resilience and AI), owning interpretations, procedures and templates applied consistently across all SGS notifications and executing affiliates.
* Qualify, authorise and monitor certification personnel under the One NoBo competence scheme, enabling EU-bound certification to be delivered locally under EU notifications.
* Lead the adoption of digital and AI tools in the certification process, keeping every conformity-assessment decision under qualified human control.
* Bridge One NoBo with SGS notified capacity in Spain, including the Rail Notified Body.

**Key Accountabilities**

* **AI-enabled machinery –** Build SGS assessment capability for machinery and safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning (Annex I Part A), and for the AI-related health and safety requirements being added to the Regulation through Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
* **Cybersecurity of machinery –** Build SGS assessment capability for protection against corruption and for the safety and reliability of control systems (Annex III, sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1), including the interface with the Cyber Resilience Act and the IEC 62443 series.
* **Technical review and decision –** Perform technical file reviews and, once qualified, take certification decisions for machinery files routed under the selected SGS notification, in line with ISO/IEC 17065.
* **Technical advisory –** Develop and deliver technical advisory services on the Machinery Regulation, including AI and cyber requirements, for SGS affiliates and clients, kept strictly separate from the certification of the same clients in line with ISO/IEC 17065 impartiality requirements.
* **SGS NoBos network –** Develop, release and maintain One NoBo procedures, checklists and certificate templates, harmonising practice across SGS Notified Bodies and supporting their international collaboration.
* **Competence and qualification –** Own the One NoBo competence matrix (person × scope × authorisation) in ProCert; define qualification criteria, perform witness assessments and monitor evaluators in executing affiliates, including SGS China.
* **Accreditation and notification –** Support accreditation assessments and notifying-authority applications for machinery scope; represent SGS in the European coordination group of Notified Bodies for machinery (NB-M) and apply its Recommendations for Use.
* **Authorised affiliates –** Plan and perform One NoBo process assessments of authorised affiliates against the One NoBo Policy, follow up findings and report results to the One NoBo Committee.
* **AI in certification –** Act as product owner for AI-assisted certification workflows (AI Bot portfolio, ProCert integrations): define requirements, validate outputs, manage data governance and ensure AI never issues deliverables or takes conformity decisions.
* **Platform and KPIs –** Act as ProCert key user for machinery workflows; monitor turnaround time, certificates issued and resource utilisation through Power BI and drive corrective actions.
* **Collaboration with SGS Spain –** Work with SGS Spain, including the Rail Notified Body, to share experience and qualified resources and to align processes within the One NoBo framework.
* At all times, comply with SGS Code of Integrity and Professional Conduct and with the impartiality requirements of the Notified Body.

  
**Qualifications**

**Core Competencies**

* Sound technical judgement, impartiality and integrity
* Structured, evidence-based and documented decision-making
* Delivery focused, biased to action
* Learning agility with digital and AI tools
* Strong collaboration across cultures in a matrix organisation
* Clear written and verbal communication, including to authorities and accreditation bodies
* Self-motivated and able to work independently

**Skills & Knowledge**

* **NoBo framework –** In-depth knowledge of the New Legislative Framework (Regulation (EC) 765/2008, Decision 768/2008/EC), the Blue Guide, and the role, obligations and impartiality requirements of Notified Bodies.
* **Accreditation –** ISO/IEC 17065 in depth; working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17020, 17021-1 and 17025 and of competence management in conformity assessment bodies.
* **Machinery Regulation –** Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, including the essential health and safety requirements of Annex III and the conformity assessment procedures; Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and the transition between the two.
* **Machinery standards –** EN ISO 12100, EN ISO 13849-1/-2, EN IEC 62061 and relevant type-C standards; functional safety assessment (PL/SIL) of safety-related control systems.
* **Cyber and software –** Protection against corruption and safety and reliability of control systems under the Regulation; IEC 62443 series; interplay with the Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847).
* **AI regulation –** Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), in particular high-risk AI systems as safety components of products, and its integration into the Machinery Regulation through Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
* **AI technical –** Machine-learning lifecycle, data quality, verification and validation of AI-based safety functions; ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894 and ISO/IEC TR 5469.
* **AI tools –** Practical use of generative AI tools, prompt design, and the ability to specify, test and validate AI-assisted workflows with appropriate data protection.
* **Digital –** Certification management platforms (ProCert or similar), Power BI, SharePoint; Python or low-code automation is an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years in a Notified Body or conformity assessment body for machinery (technical file review, EC/EU type-examination, quality system assessment), with documented qualification as assessor or reviewer.
* Direct experience of accreditation assessments and notifying-authority processes.
* Experience in functional safety assessment of machinery control systems.
* Experience in deploying or validating digital or AI tools in a regulated or technical environment – advantageous.
* Experience working with international affiliates, including APAC, in a matrix organisation – advantageous.
* Exposure to the Rail Interoperability Directive (EU) 2016/797 – advantageous.

**Qualifications**

* Must – Master's degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics or automation engineering, or equivalent.
* Must – business-grade English and fluent Spanish.
* Desirable – functional safety qualification (e.g. FS Engineer, CMSE).
* Desirable – formal AI training or qualification (e.g. ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, machine-learning coursework).
* Desirable – Auditor/Lead Auditor qualification (ISO 19011) issued by an accredited body; additional language capability.

**Performance Indicators & Deliverables**

* Machinery Regulation procedures and templates released in ProCert and in use within 6 months of onboarding.
* Number of resources qualified and authorised for machinery under One NoBo (including China) versus annual plan.
* Turnaround time of machinery files routed through One NoBo versus annual target.
* Share of machinery projects managed in ProCert (target 100%).
* No major findings on machinery scope in accreditation and notification assessments.
* AI-assisted workflows validated and deployed, with measured time saved and no conformity decisions taken by AI.
* Process assessments of authorised affiliates completed as planned.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a flexible schedule and remote work model with some visits per month to our office in Madrid.
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.
* Benefit from a comprehensive benefits platform.

**Apply Now**:  
At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Conversational AI / Voice UX Designer to help shape the next generation of AI-powered customer experiences.

In this role, you will design natural, intuitive, and effective conversational experiences for autonomous AI agents that interact with customers through voice and digital channels.

Working closely with Forward Deployed Engineers, AI specialists, product teams, and customers, you will translate business requirements and customer journeys into conversational experiences that balance usability, efficiency, and business outcomes.

Unlike traditional rule-based chatbots, our AI agents can understand context, reason across multiple steps, and execute actions on behalf of customers. Your challenge will be to make these capabilities accessible through conversations that feel natural, trustworthy, and effortless.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Conversational Experience Design**

* Design end-to-end conversational experiences for AI agents, primarily focused on voice interactions.
* Define conversation flows, dialogue patterns, agent personality, tone of voice, and communication guidelines.
* Design natural interactions that account for interruptions, ambiguity, clarifications, context retention, and unexpected user behavior.
* Create effective fallback strategies, error recovery mechanisms, and seamless escalation to human agents.
* Ensure conversational experiences are accessible, inclusive, and aligned with customer expectations.

**Agentic AI Experience Design**

* Translate complex business processes into intuitive conversational journeys that leverage autonomous AI capabilities.
* Design interactions where AI agents can gather information, make decisions, execute actions, and guide users through multi-step processes.
* Define appropriate conversational boundaries, confirmation mechanisms, and user control over AI-driven actions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize agent instructions, conversational behaviors, and orchestration from a UX perspective.
* Balance conversational flexibility with predictability, reliability, and business requirements.

**UX Research & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze customer journeys, use cases, and user needs to identify opportunities for conversational automation.
* Conduct conversation reviews, usability testing, and iterative design improvements.
* Analyze transcripts and interaction metrics to identify friction, misunderstandings, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering and customer teams to continuously refine conversational experiences based on real-world usage.
* Help define and track conversational quality metrics, including task completion, containment, customer satisfaction, and interaction efficiency.

* Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, intuitive conversational experiences.
* Experience analyzing user interactions and using qualitative or quantitative insights to improve UX.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and customers.
* Professional proficiency in English.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience designing conversational experiences for contact centers, customer service, or enterprise automation.
* Practical experience with LLM-powered conversational agents and agentic AI systems.
* Familiarity with prompt design, AI behavioral instructions, and conversational guardrails.

**What Success Looks Like**

* AI agents deliver natural, coherent, and effective conversational experiences.

* Conversational friction, unnecessary repetitions, and failed interactions are progressively reduced.
* Engineering teams receive clear, actionable conversational design specifications.

description:
**About us**
============

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

**About the role**
==================

We are hiring one Head of Product who is personally accountable for the quality, monetization and retention of a consumer product in the Utility niche, used by millions of people and monetized through a web-to-web subscription trial.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a coordination role. You will use Claude and Claude Code daily to research, prototype, spec, test and sometimes ship product yourself. You will own the roadmap, the standard of what reaches production, and the team that delivers it.

We are resetting how we build. The goal is fewer things shipped properly, not more things shipped fast: every funnel works, every release is tested, and every feature earns its place with data. Quality is the first job; ARPU and retention growth follow from it.

**Key responsibilities**

**Quality and delivery (the first accountability)**

* Own the quality bar for everything in production. If a funnel is broken or a release regresses, it is your problem and you fix the process, not only the bug.
* Run the delivery rhythm: daily stand-ups with engineering and QA, sprint planning, release go/no-go. Limit work in progress. No new feature starts while a critical bug is open.
* Write specs engineers can build from without guessing: user story, edge cases, analytics events, acceptance criteria and test cases. Review what ships against them.
* Work with QA to build regression coverage for the revenue-critical journeys and to monitor them in production.
* Define what “done” means: tested, instrumented, flagged, rolled out in stages and watched after release.

**Hands-on building with AI**

* Use Claude and Claude Code every day to research, analyze data, prototype flows, write specs and reproduce bugs. You can build a working prototype or a small fix yourself instead of waiting for a ticket.
* Judge AI output critically. You know the difference between a demo and something good enough to be number one in the niche, and you hold the team to it.
* Set the AI-first working standards for the product team: shared prompts, Claude Code conventions, review practices and design-to-code workflow.

**Team building**

* Hire and lead the product team around you, for example product managers, QA and design, as the scope requires. Every hire must work fluently with AI tools.
* Define roles, hiring bar and onboarding. Coach people, give direct feedback and remove people-process blockers.

**Product strategy and roadmap**

* Own one prioritized roadmap, built from user research, funnel data and competitor analysis. Say no to things that do not move quality, conversion or retention.
* Keep a living competitor teardown (flows, pricing, paywalls, onboarding, features) and use it to set the quality benchmark.
* Partner with the Managing Director on priorities and trade-offs, and report progress on a fixed cadence.

**Monetization and ARPU**

* Own D7 and D30 ARPU and trial-to-paid conversion. Run pricing, packaging and paywall experiments end to end: hypothesis, design, sample size, rollout, read-out.
* Find untapped revenue (plans, upsells, add-ons, cross-tool usage) and rank by impact.

**Retention and engagement**

* Own retention and churn targets. Use cohort analysis to find drop-off and friction, then fix them with onboarding, engagement loops and a clean cancellation and support experience.

**Research and data**

* Run continuous discovery with real users: interviews, session replays, support tickets, reviews.
* Define product metrics, keep the tracking plan accurate and make decisions from data, not opinion.

**Growth collaboration**

* Work with CRO and marketing so landing pages, messaging and onboarding match what the product delivers, and plan launches together.

**Must-have experience**

* **Product leadership:** 5+ years in product for D2C subscription products (web-to-web, web-to-app), including 2+ years as a senior or lead PM, ideally as the single accountable owner of one product.
* **Quality track record:** You can show a product you took from buggy or unstable to reliable. You can explain the release process, QA setup and metrics you introduced, and what changed.
* **Builder skills:** You build things yourself. Show us a prototype, internal tool or shipped feature made with Claude Code or similar, and explain how you directed the AI and checked its output.
* **Daily AI workflow:** Claude or an equivalent is part of how you research, analyze, spec and prototype every day, not an occasional helper.
* **Technical fluency:** You write precise requirements, join architecture and trade-off discussions, read code well enough to review a pull request and reproduce a bug.
* **Monetization and retention:** Measurable growth in ARPU and retention, including pricing, paywall or packaging experiments you ran end to end.
* **Funnels and UX:** Deep understanding of high-converting consumer journeys (onboarding, paywall, checkout, cancel) and the discipline to test every step.
* **Analytics and experimentation:** Hands-on with Mixpanel (or similar) and SQL or BI tools. You design and read A/B tests and manage feature flags and staged rollouts.
* **Research and competitor analysis:** A repeatable method for user discovery and for benchmarking competitors, with examples of decisions it changed.
* **Team building:** Experience hiring and leading product, QA or design people, ideally in an AI-first way of working.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with utility or productivity consumer products, or with high-traffic SEO-driven products.
* Exposure to paid acquisition (Meta Ads, Google Ads) and how traffic quality affects trial conversion and retention.
* Experience with payments, billing, trials and cancellation flows, including refund and chargeback reduction.
* Hands-on experience with test automation (Playwright, Cypress) or session-replay and error-monitoring tools.
* Experience with Claude Design or similar AI design tools for fast UI iteration.

**Leadership attributes**

* **Radical ownership:** You treat the product as your own. A bug in production or a broken funnel bothers you more than a missed feature date.
* **Quality obsession:** You care about the details of UX, specs and outcomes, and you push back,

including on leadership, when something is not good enough to ship.

* **Disciplined pace:** You know speed without quality is slower. You limit work in progress, say no, and sequence work so it lands finished.
* **Structured and analytical:** You turn ambiguous problems into hypotheses and tests, and your

conclusions rest on data.

* **Builder mindset:** You prefer to prototype, test and show over writing long documents.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex ideas simply to non-technical stakeholders and give engineers precise technical context.
* **Talent magnet:** You attract and grow strong people, and you set a bar others rise to.

**This role is not for you if**

* You prefer to manage a backlog and hand work to others rather than get hands-on with the product and the AI tools.
* You measure yourself by features shipped rather than by funnels that work and revenue retained.
* You need a large team of project managers, researchers and designers around you to function from day one.
* You are not comfortable owning a production problem and its root cause in public.

**Location**
============

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Technical Interview (90 minutes)
* Final Interview (60 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

We are a remote-friendly company, all of our previous companies were remote-friendly companies, and we intend to remain a remote-friendly company.

* Experience building or scaling engineering organisations, ideally to 50-100 engineers.

### **What We Offer**

* Collaborative, horizontal team structure that values your expertise and ideas
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to enhance your skills and career growth
* Competitive salary and benefits package

title: Product Designer
description:
**Make a stressful moment feel easy, for the person waiting for help and for the colleague sending it.**

Viking has been helping people in trouble since 1956. We are now building our own product team in Spain, and this is our first design role for the group. You'll shape our design language across our products, from the tools our agents and dispatchers use every hour to the self-service our customers will use when something goes wrong.

Not everything here is decided yet, and some days a problem in production will change your plans. If that sounds like a reason to join, we'd like to hear from you.

### **What you'll do**

* Build a design system that every product team uses, and look after it
* Design both sides of each flow: the colleague handling the case and the customer waiting for help
* Do your own research: listen to calls, sit with agents and dispatchers, test with customers
* Prototype early, so we can react to something real before we build it
* Design for when things go wrong: no signal, wrong data, or an AI suggestion that is incorrect
* Write the words in the product, not only the screens
* Work with developers, product owners and the business from first sketch to release

### **What we're looking for**

* Several years designing complex software that people use to get their work done
* A design system you built that other people adopted
* Experience designing for both internal users and customers
* A portfolio that shows how research shaped your decisions, not only the final screens
* Excellent working English

It's a bonus if you have worked with accessibility (WCAG) or white-label products, come from insurance, assistance, logistics or healthcare, prototype in code or with AI tools, or speak Spanish or a Scandinavian language.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you learn, think, and work with others than about a perfect match.

### **You as a person**

* You're curious about how people actually work
* You're clear when you present and defend a design choice
* You're happy to start from a blank page and set up the process
* You stay calm when something breaks, and you look for the next step rather than someone to blame

### **What we offer**

* Work that matters: what you design helps people when they need it most
* The first design role in the group: you set the standard every team builds on
* Competitive conditions and benefits in line with local practice
* A collaborative, supportive culture and room to grow in an international company
* Learning budget, equipment and social activities with the team

### **Where you'll work**

Torrevieja or Fuengirola, Spain. Hybrid, usually at least three days a week in the office, and we agree the details in the interview. We can't hire for remote work. Some travel: team kick-offs about once a quarter, and user sessions in our Nordic offices. Permanent, full-time, Spanish contract. Collective agreement: Convenio Colectivo de Contact Center, with the IT roles classified under Grupo C – Personal Técnico en informática.

### **How to apply**

Apply here with your CV and, if you have one, a link to your portfolio. If you want, add a few lines on why this role caught your eye. We read every application ourselves and reply within a week. The process usually takes five to seven weeks, and you'll find every step on our IT page. Questions? Write to Anali Molina, Head of Software Development.
