title: PRODUCT MANAGER – REWARDED OFFERS
description:
##### **WHO WE ARE**

At **Macadam**, we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over **15 million users worldwide**, we help people turn daily steps into positive habits that improve health and wellbeing.

Our product sits at the intersection of **gamification, lifestyle and wellbeing**, with a colourful, playful, character-driven universe rooted in mobile gaming.

##### **THE ROLE**

Users earn Macadam's coins by walking, and also by doing things our partners pay for: playing games in offerwall, taking surveys, shopping through cashback, completing brand challenges. These rewarded offers are one of our largest revenue streams, and the work is only getting bigger.

We're creating a dedicated Rewarded Offers squad and looking for its first Product Manager. You will sit in a small, autonomous team: you, a senior full-stack developer, and support from a designer and a data analyst. You report to our Head of Product, and will partner closely with the Revenue team in charge of partner negotiation. You own the problem and the outcome: more users earning through offers every day, with a healthy margin. You frame it, decide what matters, ship with the team, then read the numbers and make the call. And where the change is small, you build it yourself.

This is a role for someone with a "product builder" mindset, looking to take strong ownership and to deliver high impact.

***This role is based in Barcelona. We're looking for candidates who are already living in the city or ready to relocate.***

##### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the squad's metrics: the share of daily users who complete an offer, revenue and margin per earning user, for offerwall, survey and affiliation.
* Own the roadmap: frame the problem, prioritise hypotheses, write product specs, run A/B tests, read results, and decide next steps.
* Integrate new providers with your developer, help rank offers by what they actually earn, and keep the rewards economy healthy.
* Work with the Revenue team and our partners (offerwall and survey providers, affiliate networks) to turn market opportunities into product changes, with care for fraud and compliance.
* Build end-to-end with AI: deliver product features, from initial design and prototyping to production, when the technical environment allows.
* Grow with the squad: the scope widens as the team does, with the option of more developers over time.

##### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* 2–4 years in product management (or a close role, such as growth, product analyst or product owner with features you shipped end to end), ideally on a consumer mobile app.
* Solid data and problem-solving mindset: you can pull a funnel, define a metric, run an A/B test and tell when a result doesn't hold up. SQL or a BI tool (Metabase, Mixpanel, Amplitude or similar) is a plus.
* Experience working side by side with developers on trade-offs and scope.
* Advanced AI proficiency & technical fluency: a habit of working with AI tools to conduct user research and competitive analysis, and to set up automated workflows that accelerate product discovery and execution.
* Design and user experience sensitivity.
* Autonomy and judgement: you propose the plan and don't wait for one.
* Clear written English. French or Spanish is a strong plus.

##### **NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with offerwalls, surveys, affiliate, cashback, or marketplaces.
* Background in gaming, gamified or rewards products.
* Familiarity with partner integrations (APIs, postbacks, attribution), fraud and reward integrity, and technical understanding.
* Interest in behavioural design.

##### **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Real ownership of a revenue-critical area, reaching 15+ million users.
* Direct work with a senior full-stack developer, and the chance to build your own squad.
* Growth, learning and exposure in an international team.
* Offices in the heart of **Barcelona**.
* Hybrid working culture with international flexibility.
* Meal voucher.
* Wellness allowance (Wellhub).
* Private healthcare (Alan).
* 4 extra Macadam holiday days.
* Friday team lunch.
* Company events and offsites.

##### **WHY MACADAM?**

We don't just talk about change, we walk it. Our principles:

***Make it happen***: take ownership, drive outcomes that matter.

***Build together, win together***: support and challenge each other to go further.

***Trust the data***: decide clearly, act confidently, measure what counts.

***Build for people***: design with empathy, simplicity, real humans in mind.

***Think bigger***: set the bar high, push boundaries, imagine better ways.

Want to see what we're about? Check out our website, Linkedin, Notion and Instagram page.

*Macadam is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team.*

###### **Come walk with us. Join the movement and become a part of something meaningful!**

title: Stock & Pricing Controlling Manager
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As Stock & Pricing Controlling Manager, you will be a key business partner, working alongside the Stock & Pricing Manager to provide the CFO with relevant, accurate analytical insight that guides the Company's decisions and direction.

The role will sit under the **Finance & Legal department** based in Madrid HQ and reporting to the Head of Stock & Pricing Controlling.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Support business planning and decision-making by preparing and consolidating financial forecasts and reporting on key business drivers, including margin, stock, depreciation and pricing. Assess the profitability and risks of proposed initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company's overall strategy.
* Oversee stock valuation and depreciation throughout the financial cycle, from closing analysis to budget and forecast preparation. Work closely with Merchandising and Supply Chain to optimize inventory levels through the OTB process and stock forecasting.
* Manage global inventory performance to ensure alignment with company KPIs, identifying opportunities and driving stock reallocations across markets where needed.
* Monitor and control margin performance, providing clear analysis of variances against prior year and forecast, and identifying the key drivers behind business performance.
* Ensure pricing accuracy and consistency across markets, coordinating with local teams and working closely with Product and IT to monitor and maintain pricing information in the system.
* Monitor and analyse key business KPIs, including sales performance by collection, product sell-through and margin, providing insights to support business decisions.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role (requirements):**

* 6+ years of experience in Financial Controlling, FP&A or similar positions.
* Strong business acumen and strategic mindset, combined with excellent analytical, organizational and interpersonal skills, as well as a proactive and results-oriented approach.
* Ability to bring fresh perspectives and drive improvements, leveraging previous experience and creativity in an international business environment.
* Fluent English is essential. Spanish and French are considered a plus.
* Advanced MS Office skills, particularly Excel (Pivot Tables, charts and data analysis) and PowerPoint.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios (German speaking)
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

You are a curious, versatile creative who is developing genuine range across disciplines and creative practices. You take craft seriously and bring energy and rigour to everything you touch. As a Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the intersection of multiple creative practices, working with directors, designers, consultants, and clients to shape work that is both beautiful and effective. Versatility is your superpower.

You are building hands-on creative ability across more than one discipline. You are developing an understanding of how different creative practices connect — and how to flex between them depending on what a project needs. You are growing more comfortable across multiple creative formats and contexts. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are genuinely interested in where culture, business, and design are heading next.

You are developing your cross-disciplinary instincts. You are curious about how different creative practices connect and influence each other, and you are beginning to see how your work fits into a larger creative whole. You know that frameworks are the starting point. The willingness to learn what a project actually needs — and the craft to deliver your part of it with care — is what makes you valuable here.

You work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior creatives. You participate in creative conversations, contribute to translating briefs into compelling work, and are developing a point of view that spans more than one creative practice. You execute across projects end-to-end, bringing your skills to the right moments under the direction of more experienced team members. Your growing breadth is your differentiator. The quality of your craft is your responsibility.

Day to day, you will:

* Contribute to creative projects from first brief to final delivery, executing with care and quality across the disciplines and touchpoints you are responsible for.
* Work with briefs and strategic direction to produce clear, compelling creative across multiple formats — developing your instinct for which approach fits a given moment.
* Participate in client-facing creative work. Attend workshops, support the presentation of ideas, absorb feedback with curiosity, and apply it to your work quickly and thoughtfully.
* Contribute across creative practices with growing confidence, bringing genuine craft wherever the work demands it — and being willing to stretch beyond your primary comfort zone.
* Work with AI as a skilled collaborator. Use it to explore ideas, accelerate production, and pressure-test decisions. Keep human creativity and craft at the centre of everything that goes out the door.
* Contribute to a high creative standard. Share your perspective when it adds value, engage constructively in feedback, and actively learn from the senior creatives and different disciplines around you.
* Stay ahead of where design, culture, and communication are going. Bring fresh perspective into the studio and into client conversations — not just within your own practice, but across the creative landscape.
* Stay curious about the full shape of a project. Begin to connect the dots between what different practitioners are solving and what the work ultimately needs to achieve.

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Reading a brief carefully and asking the right questions when something is unclear.
* Moving between creative disciplines with growing confidence. You are building a clear sense of what good looks like across different formats and contexts.
* Participating in the presentation of creative work, speaking clearly about the decisions behind it and taking feedback constructively.
* Supporting a project across disciplines with reliability and care. You do your piece well and stay attuned to how it fits into the wider whole.
* Using AI to speed up the right parts of a creative process without letting it flatten your thinking.
* Moving between strategic altitude and hands-on craft without losing your footing. Equally effective in a brief-setting conversation and a design review.
* Contributing your point of view with confidence, even early in your career. Good ideas can come from anywhere.
* Staying calm and focused when briefs are open or timelines are tight. You figure out what you can do and do it well.

What You'll Bring

* A degree in design, creative arts, communication, or a related field. Equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth of creative thinking and craft is equally welcome.
* 2 to 4 years working in a creative agency, brand consultancy, in-house studio, or professional services environment, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft, curiosity, and early signs of range across creative disciplines.
* Developing ability across more than one creative practice, and an eagerness to grow that range further over time.
* Some exposure to client or stakeholder-facing work, and a willingness to develop that confidence further in a supported environment.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong craft and early creative range — showing that you care about quality and are curious enough to work across more than one format or discipline.
* Practical fluency with relevant creative tools across multiple disciplines, and comfort picking up new tools as the work demands.
* An open and curious approach to AI tools, and a growing sense of where they help and where human judgment and craft matter more.
* Excellent English and German language skills; additional languages are an advantage and may be particularly valued in certain locations.

Who You'll Work With

As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most advanced design solutions.

Additional info

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.

As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

title: Customer Success Manager (Prosthetic Lab Business Unit)
description:
**Straumann Group**

Straumann Group is a global leader in solutions for tooth replacement, restorative dentistry, orthodontics and preventive dentistry. We combine innovation, excellence and a strong commitment to quality to make first-class dental care increasingly accessible to professionals and patients around the world.

With more than 11,000 employees and an international presence, we develop, manufacture and market a broad portfolio of solutions, including dental implants, biomaterials, CAD/CAM prosthetics, digital equipment, software and clear aligners. Our portfolio includes leading brands such as Straumann, Neodent, Anthogyr, Medentika, ClearCorrect and Dental Wings, among others.

As a comprehensive solutions provider, we work closely with dental professionals, clinics and laboratories, offering not only innovative products but also training, support and services that contribute to the development of clinical practices and improve the patient experience.

**Primary Position Objectives**

As a Customer Success Manager for the Prosthetic Lab Business Unit (PLBU) you will play a crucial role in understanding and meeting the unique needs of customers and markets requiring prosthetic solutions and workflows. This position involves a combination of technical expertise, customer interaction, and collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure the successful growth of Straumann Group prosthetic solution.

Additionally, together with the sales organization you will be responsible for driving sales in the assigned territories.

This position will play a key role in delivering the next generation of Straumann prosthetic solutions and digital services for dental labs.

The Customer Success Manager for PLBU reports directly to the Head of PLBU EMEA & APAC and is a highly collaborative role that works closely with the service centers, R&D teams, other Straumann business units, and the PLBU Product Management team.

The role demands expertise in prosthetic solutions and requires interpersonal skills and a customer centric mindset.

**On this role, your primary responsibilities include:**

* Drive sales by working closely with the country sales team. Providing them with overviews on sales data and products information, and ensure diligent follow up on key accounts, markets and new prospects.
* Provide technical support to clients (internal and external), addressing queries and concerns related to prosthetic solution, workflows and services.
* Build close in-depth relationships with key customers to understand current and future needs.
* Collaborate with the product development and design teams to translate client specifications into technically feasible solutions.
* Provide market intelligence on new customer requirements as well as gathering information on competitors and their solutions.
* Educate clients (internal and external) on the features and functionalities of the Straumann Group prosthetics solutions.

**Profile**

* Highly customer obsessed and have a good understanding of the dental market (prosthetics) customer requirements.
* Dental prosthetic expertise.
* Good knowledge of digital technologies and workflows.
* Fluent in spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset
* Objectives driven and are comfortable working in a fast-paced work environment and cross functional teams.
* A dental technician or have at least 3 years experience in customized prosthetic solutions.
* Customer centric and enjoy continuous interaction with customer.
* Familiar with customer analytics, data and digital solutions, and have a track record of using data in developing and delivering customer insights to support rational decision-making and business growth.
* Additional education on business or team management is an asset.
* In-depth understanding of the commercial business with the ability to influence, challenge and innovate to enable commercial strategic imperatives .
* A strategic mindset, with strong capability to clearly communicate and foster alignment in across all levels of the organization
* Willing to travel to at least 30% of your time.
* Other duties may be assigned, so flexibility in this sense is required.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.*

title: Director of Human Resources — Arquetipo Studio
description:
### **Build what Europe must own**

Building the companies behind Europe’s strategic sovereignty.

Our mission is to originate, operate and capitalise the European companies and technologies our sovereignty depends on.

We are a venture builder focused on dual-use deep tech. Every company we launch is born inside the studio, with its own team, capital and method, and goes to market ready to compete.

We work across three missions:

* **Spectrum Dominance.** Capabilities to operate in, protect and manage data across contested environments.
* **Sovereign Compute.** Secure, certifiable European silicon, ready for post-quantum cryptography.
* **Trusted Autonomy.** High-integrity mission autonomy for uncrewed systems.

Build with us.

### **The role**

We are looking for Arquetipo’s first Head of Human Resources. You won’t inherit a department: you’ll design from scratch how a venture builder attracts, organises, develops and retains Europe’s scarcest talent.

You will report directly to the COO. Your scope won’t be a single company but a system: the studio and each of the ventures born from it, each at its own stage of maturity.

This role isn’t for everyone. If you’re looking for a position with established processes, a large team and a low profile, this isn’t it. If you want your work to show in a continent’s technological capability, read on.

### **What you’ll do**

#### **Talent for critical missions**

* Design and execute the strategy for attracting technical and executive talent to the studio and its ventures.
* Run the recruitment policy, ensuring our talent is aligned with our goals and values.
* Build our own channels with universities, research centres and the wider tech ecosystem, and turn Arquetipo’s mission into an employer brand that attracts people who want to build, not just work.

#### **Organising a venture builder**

* Define the HR management model, tools and ways of working.
* Prepare each venture for independence: its own structure, policies and people team at the moment of spin-out.
* Coordinate employment management across a multi-entity, multi-site environment spanning Madrid, Málaga, Bilbao and our ventures’ locations.

#### **Culture and accountability**

* Translate our values into observable behaviours and real criteria for hiring, evaluation, promotion and exit.
* Design a performance system with clear objectives, identified owners, continuous feedback and consistent consequences.
* Establish a development programme for studio and venture leaders so they lead by example.

#### **Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with employment law and with the specific requirements of the sectors we operate in.
* Drive and oversee the company’s ethics and compliance programme as it relates to people.

#### **What we expect at 90 days**

* Hiring for critical positions under way.
* HR management procedures up and running.
* A standard hiring process, with explicit values assessment, operating across all open positions.
* A proposed compensation & benefits framework.

#### **What we expect at 12 months**

* Critical positions in the hiring plan filled on time.
* An accountability-based performance system in place across the studio and the ventures.
* An HR management model and people playbook that let us launch a new venture in weeks, not months.
* People metrics (turnover, time-to-hire, quality of hire, engagement) presented and defended quarterly before the leadership team.

### **What you need: technical skills**

#### **Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Human Resources.
* Experience building an HR function from scratch or leading rapid growth in a technology, industrial or engineering company.
* Proven experience hiring scarce technical profiles: hardware, embedded software, critical systems or R&D.
* Strong command of Spanish employment law.
* Experience designing compensation & benefits policies.
* Analytical judgement: you make decisions based on data.
* Professional English (C1 or above).
* Availability to work on-site in Madrid and to travel.
* Eligibility to obtain a personal security clearance.

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience in defence, aerospace, semiconductors, space or other regulated sectors.
* Experience in venture builders, startup studios, groups with multiple portfolio companies or corporate innovation units.
* Postgraduate studies in People Management, Industrial Relations, Organisational Psychology or a related field.

### **What you need: values and ways of working**

Technical skills get you through the door. These decide whether you stay.

* **Accountability.** When something fails in your area, you don’t look for explanations elsewhere. And you build systems so the rest of the team can do the same.
* **You lead by example.** You never ask anyone to do what you wouldn’t do yourself. If you demand transparency or rigour, you’re the first to show it.
* **The mission guides your decisions.** You understand why technological sovereignty matters and turn it into concrete people decisions, even uncomfortable ones.
* **You’re part of the business, not a support function.** You understand the mission, the product, the cash plan and the technical challenges of each venture.
* **You combine closeness with high standards.** You care for people without lowering the bar. You have difficult conversations respectfully, on time and without beating around the bush.
* **Your decisions are guided by our values.** They are the criteria you act on.
* **You do first, then delegate.** At this stage you’ll write policies, run interviews and review contracts yourself. The team will come when the system and growth justify it.
* **Confidentiality.** You’ll handle sensitive information about programmes, partners and people. Discretion is part of the job, not an extra.

### **What we offer**

* The opportunity to design, from the ground up, the organisation of a venture builder that is building strategic capabilities for Europe.
* A seat on the leadership team, with direct influence over which companies we launch and with whom.
* Competitive compensation.
* Working alongside top-tier engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs in semiconductors, autonomy and artificial intelligence.

### **Our process**

* **Interview with the hiring manager** on mission, purpose and leadership style.
* **Interviews with studio and venture leaders**, including people who will work with you every day.
* **References and offer.** We’ll ask for references from people who have seen you lead, not only from those who have supervised you.

We’re not looking for the perfect CV. We’re looking for the person who best understands why we do what we do and who is willing to answer for how we do it.

description:
Our client is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative cancer therapies, they are looking for a **Clinical Operations Manager / Clinical Trial Manager** to strengthen their Clinical Operations team in **Derio - Bilbao - Spain**.

As a **Clinical Trial Manager**, you will be responsible for overseeing clinical trials, ensuring quality, regulatory compliance, and the successful progression of assigned studies. Reporting directly to the **Director of Clinical Operations**, you will be part of the **Medical and Clinical Operations Department** and will collaborate closely with both internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and select Contract Research Organizations (CROs).
* Manage and oversee CROs throughout all phases of clinical projects, with particular focus on budget control, timelines, and quality deliverables.
* Monitor the progress of assigned clinical development programs, ensuring compliance with company objectives, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Review study documentation and contribute to the development and review of clinical trial protocols, standard operating procedures, monitoring plans, and safety reports.
* Proactively identify risks, recruitment challenges, project deviations, and delays, implementing timely and effective mitigation strategies.

**Main duties**

* Participate in the operational planning and design of clinical trials.
* Identify service providers and manage Requests for Proposal (RFP) processes.
* Oversee regulatory submissions and interactions related to clinical development projects.
* Design, implement, and review tools and processes to support clinical trial execution and monitoring.
* Develop and manage clinical trial budgets, timelines, and project plans.
* Coordinate site management activities, ensuring recruitment targets and study milestones are achieved.
* Support the supply, oversight, and accountability of investigational medicinal products.
* Coordinate and supervise external vendors, CROs, and clinical project teams.
* Ensure appropriate training and the correct implementation of study procedures at investigational sites.
* Review clinical trial data and oversee risk management activities.
* Develop and implement issue-resolution and corrective action plans.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and guidelines, including **ICH-GCP**, **CFR**, and relevant local and international regulations.

description:

We are looking for an **R&D Director – Ecosystem & Commerce** to join the Cargo Business Unit leadership team.

Together with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce, this role builds, runs and scales the businesses that surround Cargospot, connect it and monetise it. Product defines what we build and why; this role owns how it is built, run and scaled.
  
  
It is also CHAMP’s lead role for AI-native engineering: making MCP and agentic access a core capability of our products, and making AI a standard part of how every CHAMP team designs, builds, tests and ships software.

**Mission**

Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation and own the technology end to end, from architecture and cloud to delivery and operations, for four lines of business:

* **Joint Business & Interline Middleware —** the leading and largest interline and joint-business system for air cargo;
* **Cargospot Pay —** a new line of business with the ambition to become the number one payment provider in air cargo;
* **MCP & Agentic Layer —** the AI-native access layer that lets customers, partners and their AI agents use Cargospot products;
* **Booking Portals & APIs —** the digital channels and APIs through which the market quotes, books, tracks and pays with Cargospot airlines.
  

In parallel, lead the adoption of AI across CHAMP’s software development lifecycle.

**Why This Role**

* **Build, not inherit —** Build a new R&D organisation and platform around four growth businesses, with the mandate to set its architecture, standards and culture.
* **Global scale from day one —** Work from an installed base of over 200 airlines and GSAs and some 5,600 forwarders and GHAs, with real data and real transaction volumes from day one.
* **Shape AI at CHAMP —** Lead MCP, agentic products and AI-assisted engineering for the whole company, not just one team.
* **Stability and visibility —** A profitable company within the SITA Group, a seat on the Cargo Business Unit leadership team and direct exposure to EXCO.

##### **Responsibilities :**

*R&D Organisation and Leadership*

* Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation: engineering managers, tech leads, architects, developers, QA and SRE/cloud engineers, across locations and time zones.
* Define team topology, roles, career paths for leadership and senior IC tracks, and a strong hiring bar; lead senior engineering hiring and talent development.
* Build an ownership-driven, high-velocity engineering culture with strict quality standards; define and support the staff retention plan aligned with CHAMP objectives.
  

*Delivery of the Ecosystem & Commerce Portfolio*

* Own engineering delivery for joint-business and interline middleware, Cargospot Pay, the MCP and agentic layer, and booking portals and APIs, against the roadmap set with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce.
* Plan capacity, sequence releases and keep committed dates credible; make trade-offs, risks and dependencies visible early.
* Productise integration: standard connectors, reusable patterns and API standards that reduce the time and cost of every new airline, partner and integration.
* Support the COO’s delivery organisation with technical leadership on implementations, and pre-sales and RFP/RFI responses with architecture and technical answers.
  

*Architecture, Cloud and Technology Ownership*

* Own the overall architecture and technology roadmap for the Ecosystem & Commerce portfolio: integration layer, event-driven and API-first design, data model and platform services, aligned with Neo and the Director of Engineering & Platform.
* Own the cloud estate for this area: infrastructure, environments, cost management (FinOps), scalability and multi-region deployment.
* Own production reliability and operations: SRE practices, observability, incident management, availability and performance targets, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure security and compliance by design, including identity and access, data protection and, for Cargospot Pay, payment-industry requirements such as PCI DSS.
* Lead build, partner or buy assessments and the technical side of strategic partnerships, including payment providers and integration partners.
  

  

*MCP and Agentic Layer*

* Architect and build the MCP and agentic layer around Cargospot products, so customers’, partners’ and CHAMP’s own AI agents can securely discover, consume and transact through our APIs.
* Define the standards for agent access: authentication and authorisation, guardrails, auditability, rate limiting and usage metering.
* Build shared AI services that other CHAMP product lines can reuse.
  

*AI in the SDLC across CHAMP*

* Lead and promote AI-assisted engineering across CHAMP: tools, skills and plugins for coding, code review, testing, triage and documentation.
* Define the governance that keeps AI-assisted delivery fast and safe: automated quality guardrails, test coverage, review policies and secure use of AI tools.
* Measure the impact with clear engineering metrics such as DORA, release reliability and capacity, and share practices and results with all R&D teams.
  

*Engineering Excellence*

* Own CI/CD, test automation, release management and engineering standards for the portfolio.
* Make R&D measurable: capacity, flow, quality and delivery metrics visible to product, BU leadership and EXCO.
  

*Working with Other Departments*

* Work as one team with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce: product defines, R&D builds and runs.
* Work closely with the Director of Engineering & Platform on shared platform services, architecture and cloud.
* Work closely with the COO’s delivery and support organisation on implementation, hypercare and support.
* Work closely with Security, Infrastructure and the CCO organisation on compliance, partnerships and customer commitments.
  

  
  
  

##### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities :**

* Proven leadership of distributed R&D organisations of 20+ engineers across several teams, countries and time zones, including managers and tech leads.
* Deep experience with integration platforms and APIs: microservices, event-driven architecture, API standards and high-volume B2B integrations.
* Strong cloud-native engineering background: public cloud, containers, CI/CD, observability, SRE and cost management.
* Hands-on leadership of AI-assisted engineering and agentic architecture, including MCP server integration and AI tooling in the SDLC.
* Experience with payments or fintech platforms, digital booking or e-commerce channels is a strong plus.
* Air cargo, freight or logistics domain knowledge is a strong plus.
* Data-driven management of engineering performance; disciplined, with high standards of quality and delivery.
  

##### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience
  

*Employment is subject to satisfactory reference and background checks, where applicable and permitted by local law.*

### **Our culture and values**

We believe happy employees create thriving work environments. With over 500 team members from 32 countries, speaking over 30 languages, CHAMP is a uniquely diverse and welcoming place to work. Our globally minded staff collaborates with clients and vendors worldwide from our offices in London, Frankfurt, Manila, and our Headquarters in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

The CDI Training & Education Manager supports the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of clinical education, nursing development, quality learning initiatives, and patient education programmes across CDI. The role contributes to strengthening clinical competence, supporting quality and patient safety standards, enabling workforce capability development, and supporting the implementation of structured clinical career pathways and leadership development initiatives. The role also helps ensure regulatory compliance and the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care by embedding consistent education, competence expectations, and learning standards into practical tools and programmes.  
Under the leadership and strategic direction of the Associate Director, the role actively contributes to shaping the competence environment across nursing and clinic staff populations by translating strategic education priorities into practical curricula, competency frameworks, learning pathways, tools, and implementation support across countries and clinics.  
The position operates in close collaboration with Nursing & Quality, Operations, HR, and multidisciplinary stakeholders to support harmonized learning approaches, competency development, and educational consistency across countries and clinics, while ensuring alignment with CDI strategic priorities and the CDI Blueprint.

Key Responsibilities  

* Support the design, development, implementation, and continuous update of nursing, clinical staff, quality, and patient education programmes, curricula, competency frameworks, and learning materials aligned with clinical standards, regulatory requirements, and organisational priorities.
* Actively contribute to the development and regular updating of competency frameworks, role-based curricula, learning materials, and structured learning pathways to support consistent clinical competence and professional development across nursing and clinic staff populations. This includes maintaining materials over time so that education content remains current, practical, and aligned with evolving clinical guidance and organisational priorities.
* Coordinate and support the delivery of education and training initiatives using blended learning methodologies, including classroom-based learning, virtual sessions, simulation activities, workplace-based learning, and digital learning solutions. The role should actively translate learning needs into fit-for-purpose delivery formats that can be adopted by countries and clinics.
* Create, update, and manage educational content within Learning Management Systems (LMS), including e-learning modules, competency assessments, structured learning pathways, learning records, and training documentation.
* Support onboarding programmes, role-based competency development, mandatory training activities, and continuous professional development initiatives for nursing and clinical populations.
* Contribute to the implementation and ongoing support of leadership development programmes and workplace-based learning initiatives to enhance staff development, student/staff learning experience, and local capability building.
* Support the design, implementation, and promotion of clear clinical career pathways, contributing to skill development, staff progression, retention, succession planning, and professional growth within clinical environments.
* Collaborate with Nursing & Quality, Operations, HR, clinic leadership, and multidisciplinary stakeholders to identify learning needs, clinical practice gaps, competency gaps, quality improvement opportunities, and workforce development priorities.
* Support the monitoring and evaluation of training effectiveness through participation metrics, competency validation, learner feedback, quality indicators, patient care outcomes, and operational outcomes.
* Create, review, update, and support the implementation of patient education materials and programmes, ensuring accessibility, cultural appropriateness, alignment with clinical guidance, and patient-centered care principles. This includes supporting countries with practical implementation and adaptation where needed, while ensuring consistency with central clinical guidance.
* Lead and coordinate harmonization and sharing of best practices, educational standards, tools, and learning approaches across countries and regions where applicable.
* Participate in regional and international projects related to clinical education, workforce capability, nursing development, quality initiatives, and patient education.
* Provide practical input, tools, and implementation support to countries and clinics to help embed consistent competence expectations, education practices, and learning standards, while escalation, strategic prioritisation, and final governance remain with the Associate Director.

Educational Background & Professional Experience  

* Registered Nurse with current or previous clinical practice experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Healthcare, Education, Healthcare Management, or a related clinical field required.
* Master’s degree or additional qualification in Clinical Education, Adult Learning, Leadership, Healthcare Quality, Organisational Development, or related disciplines is considered an advantage. Practical teaching experience in clinical or adult education settings is also considered an asset.
* Experience within dialysis, renal care, hospital, clinical operations, healthcare quality, nursing development, or regulated healthcare environments is considered an advantage.
* Experience working in multicultural and international healthcare environments and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.
* Exposure to competency management, workforce capability development, clinical onboarding, career pathway frameworks, healthcare learning programmes, or LMS-based education environments is considered beneficial.

Required Profile  

* Strong clinical and healthcare background with experience in nursing, clinical education, healthcare training, workforce capability development, or quality-related environments.
* Proven ability to work within matrix and cross-functional organisations supporting operational and educational initiatives across different stakeholder groups.
* Understanding of clinical governance principles, patient-centered care approaches, and healthcare quality standards.
* Typically 4–6 years of professional experience in nursing, clinical education, healthcare training, workforce development, or related healthcare learning environments.
* Proven experience developing, delivering, and maintaining nursing education, clinical training, competency development, professional development initiatives, and/or patient education programmes.
* Experience working with digital learning tools, Learning Management Systems (LMS), e-learning content, competency assessments, and blended learning methodologies.
* Understanding of competency frameworks, clinical education approaches, quality standards, workforce capability development, and clinical career pathway implementation within healthcare environments.
* Strong organisational, communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage diverse clinical and non-clinical audiences. The role should be able to translate technical clinical content into clear learning approaches for both clinical and non-clinical audiences.
* Ability to work across functions, countries, and multicultural environments.
* Strong operational coordination skills with the ability to support multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Fluent English required; additional languages are considered an asset.

This person will be working side by side with the Associate Director, in the same fast-paced environment, handling the operational and front-line work that keeps the 3 Labs running smoothly day to day. What will the Coordinator do?

* **Program administration:** send calendar invites, schedule room bookings, follow up on sessions and attendance, and keep trackers up to date across all 3 Labs.

* **Occasional support to fellows/interns:** help on specific tasks when asked by the AD; day-to-day management of fellows/interns stays with the AD.

  
Qualifications:

**To thrive in this role, you should possess the following qualifications**

**Education:**

University degree in business, communications, event management or a related field is highly recommended.

**Professional Experience:** +1-3 years of experience in a coordination or operational role (program, event or office), ideally with multiple moving parts and deadlines running at the same time.

**Nice to have:** experience at a higher education institution, or exposure to the startup/innovation ecosystem (incubators, accelerators, venture events).

**Skill area**

**What it looks like in this role**

Organizational accuracy and attention to detail

Coordinating many moving parts (calendars, rooms, sessions, trackers) across 3 Labs at once, without dropping details.

Student-facing communication

Handling queries with judgment, care and a consistent tone; knowing what to resolve directly and what to escalate to the AD

The role will be the subject matter expert on Workforce Management for their allocated markets and will work with the most senior stakeholders in Retail to optimise the largest budget in Primark. description:

**ABOUT THE WELLA COMPANY**

Based in Madrid and reporting directly to the General Manager, Southern Europe, this role will shape and accelerate profitable growth across Amazon, retailer.com, pure-play marketplaces, direct-to-consumer and emerging social commerce channels.

This is a cluster leadership role with end-to-end commercial accountability for the eCommerce agenda. The Director will combine business ownership, transformation and execution, partnering closely with local market teams and global eCommerce capabilities to translate strategy into scalable, consumer-led growth across Southern Europe.

The successful candidate will be a change agent and hands-on operator with strong expertise in Amazon and digital retail, a sharp commercial mindset, a genuine consumer lens and a proven ability to scale businesses through data-led execution, cross-functional influence and high-performing teams.

**MINDSET**

* Collaborative and influential, able to align local, cluster and global stakeholders behind a common agenda.

* Commercial: P&L management, revenue growth, investment prioritization and performance management.
* Digital and analytical: eCommerce platforms, digital shelf, CRM, retail media, attribution, forecasting and measurement.

Work Type

On-site

About the Role

Lead all JV IT application strategy, portfolio management, launch, and operation. Work with Ford and Geely to ensure that all integrations and JV applications meet business requirements. Define the application technology roadmap and migrate the Ford and Geely applications in Ford Geely Espana into independent JV applications.

Key Responsibilities

* **Corporate Systems Strategy and Roadmap:** Define and own the corporate systems strategy and multi-year roadmap, ensuring that application investments support the JV’s business priorities, operating model, plant readiness, and growth plans.
* **Application Portfolio Ownership:** Establish a clear view of the JV’s application portfolio, including business purpose, ownership, criticality, lifecycle, cost, risks, integrations, and dependencies. Identify duplication, capability gaps, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify or standardize.
* **Business Partnership and Demand Management:** Build strong relationships with Finance, HR, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Manufacture Engineering, Quality, and other business functions. Translate business needs into prioritized system capabilities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* **Corporate Systems Architecture and Integration:** Set application architecture principles, patterns, and standards in partnership with the Application Architect and Infrastructure & Operations, covering solution selection, integration, data flows and ownership, identity, scalability, resilience, and supportability. Promote reliable, secure, and maintainable exchange of information between enterprise systems, manufacturing-related systems, collaboration tools, and external partners.
* **ERP and Digital Application Delivery:** Provide executive ownership for ERP-related and corporate/digital application strategy, delivery, and lifecycle management, ensuring that business process design, implementation scope, data migration, integrations, requirements, development, testing, release, support, change management, operational readiness, and continuous improvement are governed effectively.
* **Platforms and Collaboration Tools:** Provide governance and service ownership for corporate platforms such as Jira/Jira Service Management, SharePoint, and Confluence, ensuring that their configuration, access, workflows, content, and support model meet JV needs.
* **Service and Application Operations:** Ensure that corporate systems have clear service owners, support arrangements, incident and problem-management processes, release controls, service-level expectations, and appropriate continuity and recovery plans.
* **New Model Launch support:** Build new or deploy existing JV’s applications to support new products (Both Ford and Geely) launch in plant, meet program milestone and integration with Ford and Geely systems.
* **Supplier and Relationship Management:** Lead relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, managed-service providers, and Ford and Geely counterparts. Establish clear responsibilities, service expectations, escalation paths, contract performance reviews, and knowledge-transfer arrangements.
* **JV Transition and Service Separation:** Lead the application workstream of the transition from Ford’s global services to the JV’s operating model. Identify shared-system dependencies, define transitional arrangements, clarify data and service ownership, and manage separation, migration, replacement, or continued-service decisions.
* **Governance, Risk, and Compliance:** Establish proportionate governance for application investment, architecture review, delivery assurance, change control, access, data handling, licensing, and audit evidence, in partnership with Security, Legal, Finance, and Infrastructure & Operations.
* **Budget and Investment Management:** Own or coordinate the corporate systems budget, forecasts, licensing, vendor spend, and investment cases. Communicate options, costs, risks, and expected business benefits to JV leadership.
* **People Leadership:** Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team that includes application architecture, digital application delivery, application engineering, ERP relationship and project management, Atlassian administration, SharePoint/Confluence administration, and communications and engagement.
* **Organizational Change and Adoption:** Ensure that system changes are supported by stakeholder engagement, training, communications, user readiness, and adoption measurement.
* **Performance and Executive Reporting:** Define and report meaningful portfolio, delivery, service, adoption, risk, cost, and supplier-performance measures to JV leadership, escalating decisions and material risks promptly.

Required Skills and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* At least 10 years of experience in leadership roles covering the following areas:
  + Leading corporate systems/applications, business applications, or application delivery in a complex organization.
  + Defining application strategy, roadmap, portfolio governance, or transformation program aligned to business outcomes.
  + Deciding enterprise application architecture, including application integration, identity and access dependencies, data flows, environments, and lifecycle management.
  + Overseeing major business-system implementations or transformations, such as ERP or other enterprise platforms, including requirements, process design, delivery governance, testing, deployment, and operational transition.
  + Managing software vendors, implementation partners, managed-service providers, contracts, service levels, escalations, and delivery risks.
  + Managing application security, privacy, data governance, access controls, change management, and audit considerations.
* Proven ability to work with business leaders and process owners to turn business requirements into prioritized technology plans and delivery outcomes.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams comprising architects, engineers, administrators, project or relationship managers, and business-facing roles.
* Experience managing application incidents, service performance, release governance, lifecycle risks, and continuous improvement in partnership with IT operations.
* Strong financial and commercial skills, including budget management, licensing oversight, investment planning, and business-case development.
* Strong communication, influencing, and negotiation skills with diverse business stakeholders, especially the two parent companies (Ford and Geely).
* Strong partnership and relationship management to adapt different country, culture, language and timing zone, JV working experience is preferred
* Professional proficiency in English;

Preferred Skills and Experience

* Experience establishing corporate systems for a new entity, JV, carve-out, greenfield site, or organization transitioning away from a parent company’s global IT services.
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or another environment with significant plant, engineering, supply-chain, or multi-shift operational needs.
* Experience with the specific ERP selected for the JV, such as Dynamics 365, SAP, or another enterprise platform.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including governance, environments, application lifecycle management, and low-code solution oversight.
* Experience with Jira and Jira Service Management, SharePoint, Confluence, or comparable workflow, service-management, and collaboration platforms.
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture methods or frameworks, ITIL practices, Agile delivery, DevOps, and structured project or program governance.
* Experience defining application integration patterns for cloud and enterprise platforms.
* Experience with enterprise application portfolio management, service catalogues, configuration management, or application rationalization.
* Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture, project or program management, IT service management, or a major enterprise application platform.

What Success Looks Like

**Short Term:**

Convert current Ford managed applications capacity to support new JV business launch on time without technology gaps. Establish the application team and application budget, working with Ford IT team to enhance the current Ford global system by integrating with Geely IT system, and support the on-time launch of all new model programs in 2027 and 2028.

**Long Term:** Leverage the best of Ford and Geely to build a competitive application footprint in the JV, be accountable for audit results, and own application cyber security and privacy. Replace the current Ford managed HR and Finance system as first priority.

**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend’s contributions help shape the built environment, impacting and evolving the way people live, work and travel. With a heritage rooted in cost, commercial and project management we have a deep and tacit understanding of capital programmes and apply this expertise to drive industry best practice and innovation.

Our Purpose is making the difference: transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world. This Purpose is grounded in the belief that we work in an industry that has the potential to transform lives, whether by helping to tackle the climate agenda or levelling up society through improved infrastructure. We can lead by transforming performance, delivering for our clients at scale and speed, raising standards and making a difference.

Globally, we operate 113 offices in 45 countries with over 11,000 colleagues.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an exceptional **Head of Industrial and Logistic Principal Delivery** to lead a high-performing business delivering workplace transformation projects across Spain. This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced professional who combines commercial acumen, operational excellence, and inspirational people leadership.

As Head of Industrial & Logistics Principal Delivery, you will be responsible for **leading and growing our Industrial & Logistics Principal Delivery business in Spain**, overseeing the successful delivery of industrial fit-out projects.

**Key objectives:**

* Lead and grow a nationally recognized I&L fit-out delivery business across Spain.
* Drive business development: identify opportunities, expand client relationships, win new projects.
* Develop a sector-specific delivery practice, including team, processes, and supply-chain capabilities.
* Provide leadership and direction to multidisciplinary project teams and delivery partners.
* Oversee project delivery performance, profitability, client satisfaction, and operational excellence.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients and key stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Additionally, the individual will be required to participate in and contribute to the established Management System through the understanding and implementation of the following:

* Compliance with Quality and Environmental policies.
* Application of the Environmental Best Practices Manual.
* Compliance with global Health and Safety (H&S) policies and standards.

**Key requirements of the role:**

The ideal candidate will be responsible for business strategy, opportunity generation, technical management, and the delivery of turnkey industrial fit-out projects, ensuring operational excellence from bidding and project set-up through to final handover. title: Expert Senior Manager, Process Excellence – Source to Pay (S2P)
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
  
  
You will join the Process Excellence team within Bain’s Applied Technology & AI practice. The team helps clients rethink how they operate, combining deep process expertise with SAP and AI to deliver measurable business results. You will be embedded in multidisciplinary teams with Bain consultants and other experts in architecture, technology delivery, data science, engineering and design, serving leading companies across industries in large SAP S/4HANA and AI-enabled transformations.
  
  
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
  
Mission
  
  

* Lead end-to-end Source to Pay transformations, from spend analysis, sourcing and contracting to supplier management, purchasing, invoicing and payment.
* Redesign S2P processes with AI built in, deciding where AI agents, machine learning and automation should run a task, support a person or stay out, with the goal of simple, touchless and well-controlled processes.
* Act as business architect and trusted advisor in SAP- and AI-enabled programs, making sure technology choices serve business outcomes rather than drive them.
* Shape the value case, operating model, governance and controls of S2P transformations, from early diagnostic through implementation and scale-up.
* Deliver measurable impact across procurement and accounts payable: savings, spend under management, compliance, productivity, user experience and working capital.

Essential functions
  
  

* Lead current-state diagnostics, fact base development and future-state blueprinting across the S2P process: spend analytics, category and sourcing strategy for direct and indirect spend, contract management, supplier onboarding and management, requisition to order, goods and service receipt, and invoice to pay.
* Define target-state process design and key design principles, including where to standardize globally and where local, statutory or control requirements call for variation.
* Identify, size and prioritize AI use cases along the S2P process, such as spend classification, sourcing and negotiation assistants, contract analysis, supplier risk monitoring, supplier collaboration on direct materials forecasts and orders, guided buying and AI-based request intake, invoice capture and matching, and agents that resolve exceptions or answer supplier queries.
* Advise clients on how AI is changing what they expect from procurement and accounts payable, and turn it into end-to-end S2P process redesign rather than isolated use cases.
* Design how people and AI agents will work together, including roles, approval and decision rights, controls, audit trail, and the supplier, material and contract data that AI needs to work at scale.
* Identify gaps between business needs and the standard capabilities of SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms, and recommend standardization versus customization trade-offs.
* Shape value cases, KPIs and benefits tracking, so that transformations and AI investments are anchored in measurable outcomes.
* Design target operating models for procurement and accounts payable, including shared services, centers of excellence and the split of responsibilities between global, regional and local teams.
* Drive integration with adjacent domains such as Finance (R2R), Plan to Fulfil (including direct materials planning, supplier scheduling and inbound), Master Data and Tax.
* Lead client workshops and decision-making sessions, challenging legacy ways of working and aligning stakeholders on leading-practice choices.
* Act as process design authority through implementation, including end-to-end test scenarios for system integration and user acceptance testing, keeping the system integrator, technical and AI teams aligned with the intended outcomes.
* Support proposal development and commercial shaping for major SAP, AI and procurement transformation programs.
* International travel is required up to 50% of working time.

ABOUT YOU
  
  
Education
  
  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in business administration, economics, engineering, information technology, business informatics or related fields.
* Preferred: Additional training in procurement or supply management (for example CIPS), finance, analytics or AI.

Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of professional experience, including significant experience in S2P process transformation within large SAP-enabled programs, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
* Extensive experience in process design and transformation across procurement, accounts payable and shared services organizations.
* Deep expertise in indirect spend and the purchase-to-pay backbone; strong preference for hands-on experience in direct procurement (for example raw materials and packaging sourcing, contracting and supplier management) and how it connects with planning and manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with AI or advanced automation in S2P processes within the last 1-2 years (for example shaping, designing, delivering or advising on a use case), with a clear view of the value delivered, the process changes it required and the lessons learned.
* Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement and leading S2P platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, GEP or equivalent, including their AI capabilities. Deep technical SAP architecture expertise is not required; the focus is functional process depth with a solid grasp of what the platforms can do.
* Able to describe what best-in-class S2P processes look like, what SAP S/4HANA and leading S2P platforms support as standard, and where companies typically customize.
* Proven success engaging senior stakeholders such as CPOs, CFOs and heads of shared services, and acting as a trusted advisor in complex transformations.
* Experience in one or more relevant industries such as consumer products, retail, industrials, life sciences or manufacturing.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Knowledge, skills and abilities
  
  

* Deep end-to-end S2P expertise, connecting sourcing, contracts and supplier management with purchasing, receipt, invoicing and payment into one coherent process design.
* Ability to define and articulate the main value drivers in S2P transformations, such as savings and savings leakage, spend under management, contract compliance, maverick spend, touchless PO and invoice rates, cycle times, cost per invoice, payment accuracy, payment terms and working capital, direct material cost and supply continuity, and supplier risk.
* Solid understanding of AI and how to apply it in procurement and finance operations: the main types (generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, process mining and automation), what each does well, its limits and the data it needs.
* Working knowledge of SAP Business AI (including Joule), SAP Business Network and the AI roadmaps of leading S2P platforms, and how they fit with the SAP S/4HANA core.
* Good judgment on when AI is the right answer and when process simplification, standardization or classic automation is enough.
* Strong understanding of internal controls, compliance and audit requirements in S2P, and how they need to change when AI agents take over tasks.
* Ability to lead both executive-level discussions and detailed L3/L4 process conversations, adapting the level of detail to the audience and project phase.
* Ability to use spend data, process mining and performance metrics to find bottlenecks, quantify opportunities and track benefits.
* Familiarity with change management and adoption approaches for requesters, buyers and accounts payable teams, including building trust in AI-supported decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a hands-on ability to create clear, ready-to-use client materials.
* Leadership skills to guide and develop small teams of junior consultants or experts.

Nice to have
  
  

* Has built simple AI prototypes or agents, for example with low-code tools such as SAP Build or Microsoft Copilot Studio, or has basic Python or SQL skills.
* Experience with process mining tools such as SAP Signavio or Celonis in S2P.
* Experience with AI-native procurement or accounts payable automation tools, including autonomous negotiation for tail spend.
* Professional certifications, such as CIPS or SAP certifications in SAP Ariba or S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement.

Visible links

description:
Botify’s leading agentic AI search technology and seasoned experts ensure every brand has the power to be found, both in traditional and AI search. With one powerful platform, brands achieve visibility, relevance, and greater control across Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and more.

Botify’s technology powers agentic workflows, AI-driven recommendations, and automated cross-platform indexation and deployment. Brands maximize visibility wherever consumers, bots, and AI agents search, protecting and capturing revenue across all search platforms.

Trusted by 500+ leading brands including Macy’s, Levi’s, Farfetch, the New York Times, and Marks & Spencer, Botify drives digital discovery, sustained profitability, productivity, and brand authority in an AI-first world.

*Industry research shows that women and those in traditionally underrepresented groups generally don't apply to jobs unless they check all the boxes for the role. If you feel strongly that you have what it takes for this role but don't check 100% of the boxes - that's okay - we encourage you to apply anyway and highlight what you can bring to the table!*

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Botify is the AI-powered search optimization platform trusted by 500+ enterprise brands across 30 countries. Our Customer Enablement team is the bridge between the platform and our customers' daily workflows: we make sure the brands we work with don't just have access to Botify, they know how to use it to move the numbers that matter. We're looking for a Customer Enablement Manager to own platform adoption and user proficiency across a dedicated portfolio of enterprise accounts.

You'll report to a Services Manager (Pod Lead) and work alongside Managed Services Consultants on shared accounts. This role exists because the gap between "licensed" and "operationalized" is where customer value is won or lost, and closing that gap is your job.

### **You are:**

We're looking for someone who gets genuine satisfaction from turning complex software into something a busy SEO team uses every day without thinking twice. Specifically, you are:

* A Platform Champion: You master enterprise software deeply enough to translate high-level features into repeatable workflows any user can follow. Configuring dashboards, building segmentation, and optimizing crawl settings to mirror a client's business structure is the kind of work that energizes you.
* A Skilled Technical Teacher: You break down technical concepts like JavaScript rendering or log file analysis into structured training that empowers users at every level, from SEO analysts to marketing directors.
* Analytical and Proactive: You spot low adoption or technical blockers before the client does and step in with a plan before they have to ask.
* Systems-Oriented: You don't just answer questions; you build solutions. When a client has a recurring problem, you look for the configuration or workflow that makes it stop recurring.
* Growth-Minded: You have a solid foundation in technical SEO and are building toward deeper technical expertise. A clear path from this role into strategic consulting exists at Botify, and we actively develop people toward it.

### **What you'll own:**

* Own onboarding and time-to-value for your portfolio. You'll lead post-sale implementation for each account, ensuring technical configurations (crawls, log connections, site mappings) are accurate and aligned to the client's business goals. Success is measured by how quickly accounts reach their first actionable insight.
* Turn casual users into power users. You'll design and deliver tailored training that builds genuine platform fluency. A power user pulls their own insights from Botify without waiting for your help.
* Build the reporting and alerting infrastructure each account relies on. You'll configure custom dashboards, alert systems, and reports that give stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of organic search performance. When those are right, Botify becomes part of the daily workflow.
* Serve as the first line of platform expertise. You'll diagnose usage issues, distinguish platform bugs from configuration problems, and partner with Technical Support or Product to resolve anything that needs escalation.
* Partner with Managed Services Consultants on shared accounts. You'll keep the platform configuration in sync with the strategic SEO roadmaps your MSC colleagues are executing.
* Feed customer signals back to Product. You'll capture and synthesize product feedback from your portfolio on a structured cadence, giving the Product team grounded input from the accounts that use the platform most.

#### **Your first 90 days:**

* Within 30 days: Complete platform and process onboarding, hold introductory calls with every account in your portfolio, and map the adoption status and top blocker for each.

* By 60 days: Own your onboarding and training delivery independently and close your first time-to-value milestone with at least one new account.
* By 90 days: Have a working adoption plan in place for every account, run your first structured product feedback session with your Pod Lead, and hit your first platform adoption benchmarks.

### **Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of technical SEO experience, in-house or at an agency, covering the full spectrum. You've worked on high-level strategy and rolled up your sleeves on technical SEO. You're not a specialist in one lane; you've navigated both.
* A strong working understanding of how search engines crawl, and what crawl behavior means for traffic and revenue. You don't just know the concepts; you've diagnosed crawl issues on real sites and connected those findings to business outcomes.
* Intermediate familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, particularly how JS affects modern search discovery and rendering.
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills. You work comfortably with data, spot patterns that others miss, and translate what you find into a clear course of action.

* Background in SEO project or program management; experience running structured SEO workstreams across multiple stakeholders.
* Experience configuring dashboards, segmentation, or custom reporting in enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Comfort picking up new technology quickly; Botify is a complex platform and curiosity about tooling goes a long way

### **Core Competencies:**

* Analytical instinct: You look at data and see the story before anyone asks you to find it.
* Technical teaching: You make complex SEO and platform concepts land clearly for users at every level.
* Proactive ownership: You monitor your portfolio continuously and act before clients have to escalate.
* Systematic thinking: You build repeatable solutions, not one-off fixes.

### **Salary:**

$95,000 - $105,000 base salary + 15% bonus

* Summer Fridays
